Before submitting, check that PDF text is selectable and the headings are intact.

en.fits: CV Desk suits holiday resume prep: an on-device ATS score with suggestions, multiple resumes tailored per job, and ATS-ready PDF plus editable .docx export. Build and preview for free, no subscription, no account.
faq: When should I start if I leave after the bonus?
Have a draft done over the holiday break so you can apply in January. Check your employment rules for notice periods.
Do Japanese-format resumes need ATS care?
Use whatever format the employer asks for first. When uploading online, a one-column career history with standard headings and selectable PDF text is the safer choice.

loc.title: Claude-Limit über die Feiertage: Nebenprojekt planen, ohne am Wochenlimit zu scheitern
loc.meta: Zwischen den Jahren das Nebenprojekt bauen? Plane nach 5-Stunden-Fenstern und Wochenlimit, damit dir am dritten Tag nicht das Kontingent ausgeht.
loc.h1: Feiertagsprojekt mit KI: so planst du um 5-Stunden- und Wochenlimit herum
loc.lead: Zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr hat man endlich Zeit für das eigene Projekt. Genau dann passiert es: Am ersten Tag läuft alles, am zweiten ist das 5-Stunden-Fenster schon mittags leer, und am dritten meldet sich das Wochenlimit.
loc.answer: Plane das Projekt in Blöcken, die zu den Limits passen: große Aufgaben an den Anfang eines frischen 5-Stunden-Fensters, kleinere Arbeiten und Lesen in die Pausen, und das Wochenlimit als Budget über alle Feiertage verteilen statt am ersten Tag zu verbrauchen.
paras: Die meisten Feiertagsprojekte scheitern nicht an der Idee, sondern am Rhythmus. Wer am ersten Tag stundenlang im selben langen Chat iteriert, verbraucht viel vom Kontingent für Kontext, der ständig neu mitgeschickt wird. Besser: vorab ein kurzes Konzept schreiben (Ziel, Dateien, Schnittstellen) und jede Sitzung mit einer klaren Aufgabe starten.

Das 5-Stunden-Fenster ist ein natürlicher Arbeitstakt. Lege die schwere Arbeit wie Architektur, größere Refactorings oder Debugging an den Anfang eines Fensters, und nutze die Zeit bis zum Zurücksetzen für Tests, Lesen, Familie oder einen Spaziergang. Das Wochenlimit dagegen ist dein Budget für die ganzen Feiertage: Teile es grob auf die Tage auf und schau, an welchem Tag es bei deinem Konto zurückgesetzt wird.

Eigene Warnungen bei etwa 90 Prozent und eine Warnung zum Zurücksetzen sagen dir, wann du pausieren und wann du weitermachen kannst.

en.h1: Planning a holiday AI side project around 5-hour and weekly limits
en.lead: The holidays finally give you time for your own project. Then it happens: day one flies, by day two the 5-hour window is empty by noon, and on day three the weekly limit shows up.
en.answer: Plan in blocks that match the limits: heavy work at the start of a fresh 5-hour window, lighter tasks and reading in between, and treat the weekly limit as a budget spread across the holidays rather than spent on day one.
paras: Most holiday projects fail on rhythm, not ideas. Iterating for hours in one long chat spends a lot of your allowance on context sent again and again. Write a short spec first (goal, files, interfaces) and start each session with one clear task.

The 5-hour window is a natural work cadence. Put architecture, big refactors or debugging at the start of a window, and use the time until reset for testing, reading or time with family. The weekly limit is your budget for the whole break: split it roughly across the days and check which day it resets on your account.

That only works if you know where you stand. UsageNow shows Claude's 5-hour session limit and weekly limits, including per-model weekly caps, plus Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini, with a live countdown to every reset. Custom alerts at a percentage like 90 and a reset alert tell you when to pause and when to start again.

loc.lead: 大檔案常被切成好幾個 RAR 分卷傳送或下載。只要少一卷、或卷放在不同地方，就怎麼樣都解不開。這一頁教你先檢查、再從正確的那一卷打開。
loc.answer: iPhone 內建的檔案 App 不能解 RAR，分卷 RAR 更需要支援分卷的解壓縮 App。把所有分卷存到同一個資料夾、確認檔名沒被改，再用 App 開啟第一卷（.part1.rar 或沒有數字的 .rar），其餘分卷會一起被讀取。Zipbox 解壓縮：RAR ZIP 7z 支援 ZIP、RAR、7z 的分卷與密碼保護壓縮檔，全部在裝置本機處理。
paras: 分卷 RAR 有兩種常見的命名。新式是 檔名.part1.rar、檔名.part2.rar 一路往下；舊式是 檔名.rar 搭配 檔名.r00、檔名.r01。不管哪一種，它們都是同一個壓縮檔被切開的片段，單獨一卷沒辦法解出完整內容。7z 的分卷則長得像 檔名.7z.001、檔名.7z.002。
解不開的原因，九成是分卷沒收齊或沒放在一起：LINE 一次傳多個檔案時，每個檔案都要各自點開再「儲存到檔案」；Safari 下載的會集中在「下載項目」，但如果有一卷是從郵件存的，就可能落在別的資料夾。另一個常見問題是檔名被改，例如下載時被加上「(1)」，讓 part2 對不上 part1，把檔名改回一致就好。
收齊之後，用支援分卷的解壓縮 App 開啟第一卷。Zipbox 解壓縮：RAR ZIP 7z 可以從檔案 App、Safari 下載項目、郵件或分享選單直接開啟，不解壓就先瀏覽清單、預覽照片、影片、PDF 和文字，只取出需要的檔案；設了密碼的分卷也能輸入密碼解開。它不連網、沒有帳號也沒有廣告，是 App Store 付費下載，一次購買包含全部功能。

en.title: How to open a multi-part RAR (part1.rar, part2.rar) on iPhone
en.meta: A download split into .part1.rar, .part2.rar or .r00, .r01 won't open on iPhone? Put every part in one folder, then open the first part. What to do about missing parts, renamed files and passwords.
en.h1: How to open a multi-part RAR archive on iPhone
en.lead: Large downloads are often split into several RAR parts. If one part is missing or sits in a different folder, nothing will extract. Here is how to check the parts and open the right one.
en.answer: The Files app can't extract RAR, and split RAR archives need an extractor that handles multi-part archives. Save every part into the same folder, make sure the names still match, then open the first part (.part1.rar, or the .rar with no number) and the rest are read with it. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z handles password protected and multi part ZIP, RAR and 7z on your device.
paras: Split RAR archives use one of two naming styles. The newer style is name.part1.rar, name.part2.rar and so on; the older style is name.rar alongside name.r00, name.r01. Either way they are pieces of a single archive, and no single part extracts the full contents on its own. Split 7z archives look like name.7z.001, name.7z.002.

Most failures come from parts that are missing or scattered. Files saved from Mail can land in a different folder from those downloaded in Safari, which go to Downloads. Another common problem is a renamed file, for example a download that picked up a "(1)" so part2 no longer matches part1; rename it back and it lines up again.

Once every part is together, open the first one in an extractor that supports split archives. Zipbox opens archives from Files, Safari downloads, Mail and the share sheet, lets you browse the list and preview photos, video, PDF and text before extracting, and pulls out only the items you need, including from password protected parts. It makes no network requests, has no account and no ads, and is a paid download with every feature included in one purchase.

Check the names: apart from the part number or the .r00-style extension, the base name must be identical.
Open the first part in Zipbox (.part1.rar, or the .rar with no number in the older style) and enter the password if there is one.
Preview the list, select what you need, then export it to Files or iCloud Drive.

en.title: Vocabulary widget for the iPhone Home Screen: set it up, pay once
en.meta: Want to see one new word every time you unlock your phone? How to add a vocabulary widget to the iPhone Home Screen, where to put it so you actually see it, and why to check for a one-time purchase.
en.h1: How to set up a vocabulary widget on your iPhone Home Screen
en.lead: You unlock your phone far more often than you open a vocabulary app. Put a vocabulary widget on the first Home Screen page and every unlock becomes one more word, which adds up to more than the occasional hour-long session.
en.answer: Touch and hold an empty spot on the Home Screen, choose to add a widget, find your vocabulary app, pick a size and place it on the first page. When choosing the app, check three things: whether the widget lets you move to the next word, whether you can save words from it, and whether it is a one-time purchase or a subscription.
paras: A widget that only shows a word soon fades into the background. An interactive widget is more useful: you move to the next word and save unfamiliar ones right from the Home Screen, then review the saved words in the app. That turns the widget into dozens of tiny reviews a day.

Placement matters more than size. Put it on the first page, where your thumb rests most, or next to the apps you open every day; a widget on the third page is quickly forgotten. If you study two languages, choose an app that keeps progress separate for each language so the words don't get mixed up when you switch.

Check how you pay, too. Building vocabulary is a long habit, and a monthly subscription keeps charging; an app you buy once stays yours. Wordmate: Learn 44 Languages is a paid download: one purchase includes all 44 languages, every level and every feature, with no subscriptions, in-app purchases or paid upgrades. Its interactive Home Screen widget lets you view a word, move to the next one or save it, and there is an Apple Watch app too.

loc.h1: Faire un planning de révision sur iPhone que l'on tient vraiment
loc.lead: Le planning parfait sur papier est souvent abandonné au bout de quatre jours. Celui qui tient est plus modeste et se vérifie tous les soirs.
loc.answer: Un planning de révision qui tient part de la date d'examen, répartit les matières à rebours, limite chaque journée à trois blocs et se coche chaque soir. Le retard se rattrape le week-end, pas en surchargeant le lendemain.
paras: La première erreur est de remplir chaque jour à 100 %. Au premier imprévu, tout le planning glisse et on l'abandonne. Prévoyez trois blocs de révision par jour au maximum et gardez le week-end comme réserve de rattrapage.

La deuxième est de planifier par chapitres vagues (« réviser l'histoire »). Écrivez des tâches qu'on peut cocher : « fiche chapitre 3 », « 20 questions d'annales », « relire les définitions ». Une tâche cochable donne un vrai sentiment d'avancer.

La troisième est de ne jamais regarder le planning. Mochi est une checklist mignonne avec des widgets pour l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé, des rappels et une app Apple Watch : la liste du jour reste sous vos yeux, et un tap sur le petit cercle coche la tâche. La version gratuite comprend 2 listes de 4 tâches maximum ; Premium (achat intégré) débloque des listes et tâches illimitées.

en.h1: Making a revision timetable on iPhone you actually stick to
en.lead: The perfect timetable on paper is often abandoned after four days. The one that lasts is more modest and gets checked every evening.
en.answer: A revision timetable that lasts starts from the exam date, spreads subjects backwards, caps each day at three blocks and gets ticked every evening. Catch up at the weekend, not by overloading tomorrow.
paras: The first mistake is filling every day to 100%. At the first surprise the whole timetable slips and you drop it. Plan three revision blocks a day at most and keep the weekend as catch-up reserve.

The second is planning in vague chunks ("revise history"). Write tasks you can tick: "flashcards chapter 3", "20 past-paper questions", "reread definitions". A tickable task gives a real sense of progress.

The third is never looking at the timetable. Mochi is a cute checklist with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, reminders and an Apple Watch app: today's list stays in view, and a tap on the little circle ticks it off. The free version includes 2 lists with up to 4 tasks each; Premium, an in-app purchase, unlocks unlimited lists and tasks.

en.h1: How to make a study plan that lasts (and keep it on iPhone)
en.lead: The more perfect the plan, the sooner it collapses. Plans that last are modest and get checked every evening.
en.answer: Work back from the exam date to spread subjects, cap each day at three tasks, tick them every evening, and catch up at the weekend rather than cramming tomorrow. That alone makes a study plan far easier to keep.
paras: The most common failure is filling every day. One missed slot shifts everything and you stop looking at the plan at all. Keep each day to three tasks and leave the weekend free for adjustment.
The second is vague wording like "do English". Write tasks with a clear finish — "50 vocabulary words", "one past paper", "summary notes for chapter 3" — so every tick feels like progress.

The third is days when you never look at the plan. Mochi is a cute checklist app with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, reminders and an Apple Watch app, so today's list is naturally in view. paras: A whole-trip budget is hard to feel. On day two the big number still looks safe even if you have already overspent. A daily limit gives one small number that is easy to compare with the price in front of you.

The issue is timing. In a queue at the counter or a food stall, pulling out the phone, opening an app and finding a report feels too slow. That is why a budget on the wrist or the Home Screen gets checked more often.

G+Money Lite lets you set an optional daily limit and see how each day tracks against it. Purchases are logged in the local currency and converted to your home currency, with a widget and Apple Watch for quick checks. Everything stays on the device, with no account.
look: A daily limit you can set, not only a trip total
A glance view on Apple Watch or a widget, without opening the app
Logging in the local currency with the home-currency value
Logging that takes seconds right after paying
Account, ads and subscription
steps: Subtract tickets and lodging you already paid, then divide the rest by the number of days.
Set that figure as the trip's daily limit.
Add the widget to your Home Screen or check it on Apple Watch.
Log each purchase right after you pay.
If one day goes over, trim a little over the next two days rather than all at once.
rows: A small number is easier to compare with a price
Watch, widget or in the app
en.fits: G+Money Lite fits trips with a daily limit you want to check on your watch and a widget. Without a purchase you get rates, budget and summary for 1 trip and 3 expenses; one payment unlocks unlimited expenses and trips, with no subscription.
faq: Do I have to set a daily limit?
No. The daily limit is optional; you can still log and see summaries without it.
Can I check without opening my phone?
G+Money Lite supports Apple Watch and a widget for quick checks.

No. Data stays on the device, with no account and no tracking. Only exchange rates are fetched from a public rate service.

loc.h1: Lumi حروف Lite: ماذا يستطيع طفلك أن يفعل قبل أي شراء؟
loc.lead: قبل أن تقرر، من المفيد أن تعرف بالضبط ما الذي يجربه طفلك مجانًا، وما الذي يضيفه الشراء الواحد.
loc.answer: دون شراء: جميع أنشطة حرف A، ومغامرة الكوكب الأول كاملة، وأول ثلاثة أنواع من الألعاب في صفحة الإنجازات. شراء واحد يفتح الحروف الستة والعشرين و14 كوكبًا و12 نوعًا من الألعاب.
paras: يستمع الطفل إلى اسم الحرف وصوته، ثم يتتبع الحرف الكبير والصغير على خطوط إرشادية تتبع ترتيب الخطوط الصحيح. هذا الترتيب مهم لأن الطفل الذي يكتب الحرف من الأسفل إلى الأعلى يعتاد على ذلك ويصعب تصحيحه لاحقًا.
يكفي حرف واحد لتعرف هل يناسب التطبيق طفلك: هل يكرر الاستماع، وهل يكمل التتبع دون مساعدة، وهل يعود في اليوم التالي. إذا حدث ذلك، فالشراء يكمل نفس الطريقة لبقية الحروف بدل أن تبدأ مع تطبيق جديد.

بعد الفتح الكامل يتدرج التعلم من التعرف على الحرف إلى الصوت الأول والصوت الأخير والحرف المتحرك في الوسط، ومطابقة الحرف الكبير بالصغير، والحروف الناقصة وترتيب الحروف. التطبيق بلا إعلانات ويعمل دون إنترنت.

تتبع الحرف الكبير والصغير بترتيب الخطوط

en.title: Lumi Letters Lite: what can your child do before any purchase?
en.meta: Lumi Letters Lite teaches the English alphabet to ages 3 to 7: letter name, sound and stroke-order tracing. The letter A and the first planet are fully open without a purchase, with no ads and offline play.
en.h1: Lumi Letters Lite: what can your child do before any purchase?
en.lead: Before deciding, it helps to know exactly what your child can try for free and what one purchase adds.
en.answer: Without a purchase: every activity for the letter A, the full first planet adventure and the first three game types on the achievements page. One purchase opens all 26 letters, 14 planets and 12 game types.
paras: Your child hears the letter's name and sound, then traces uppercase and lowercase letters along guide lines that follow the correct stroke order. Order matters: a child who draws a letter from the bottom up gets used to it, and it is hard to correct later.

One letter is enough to tell whether the app suits your child: do they replay the sounds, finish the tracing without help, and come back the next day? If so, the purchase continues the same method for the remaining letters instead of starting over with a new app.

After the full unlock, learning moves from recognising a letter to first sounds, ending sounds and middle vowels, matching uppercase to lowercase, missing letters and letter order. There are no ads and it works offline.
look: Letter name and sound together, not the name alone
Uppercase and lowercase tracing in stroke order
Enough fully open content to try before buying
No ads or surprise links
Offline play for the car or a trip
steps: Start with the letter A together: listen to the name and sound.
Let your child trace the uppercase, then the lowercase, and watch the stroke direction.
Play the listen-and-tap game that links each sound to its shape.
Finish the first planet adventure and look at the achievements page.
After two or three days, decide based on whether your child returns on their own.
rows: Early reading relies on sound more than name
A wrong habit is hard to fix later
A full letter and a full planet
You know whether your child likes it before paying
en.fits: Lumi Letters Lite fits children aged 3 to 7 starting the English alphabet at home, in short sessions a parent can join. Free to start, and one purchase opens every letter and planet.

loc.title: 奖励贴纸怎么用才有效：当下鼓励，还是周末结算？
loc.meta: 三到七岁的孩子更在意当下的回应。奖励贴纸要配合即时鼓励和固定的小任务，才不会两周就失效。Lumi Mission Planet 把刷牙、吃饭、收玩具变成小任务，免费开始。
loc.h1: 奖励贴纸怎么用才有效：当下鼓励，还是周末结算？
loc.lead: 很多家庭的贴纸表撑不过两周。问题通常不是贴纸不够好看，而是奖励来得太晚。
loc.answer: 对三到七岁的孩子，先给当下的回应，再用贴纸记录成果：每完成一个小动作就立刻有反馈，周末再一起看收集了多少，而不是把所有奖励留到周末。
paras: 年幼的孩子很难把周一刷牙和周日换到的奖励联系起来。等待太久，贴纸就变成父母的记账工具，而不是孩子的动力。即时的回应让“做了这件事”和“被看见”发生在同一刻。
任务也要够小、够具体。“乖一点”无法完成，“刷完牙”“把积木放回篮子”可以。每天固定三到五个任务，比列十几项更容易坚持；做不到的任务先拆小，而不是扣贴纸。
Lumi Mission Planet 把吃饭、刷牙、睡觉、收拾和上学准备做成每日任务，孩子每完成一小步点一下，小伙伴就会立刻跳起来欢呼。吃饭、刷牙、睡觉、收拾任务和每类的第一批贴纸免费可用；一次购买再解锁上学准备、自建任务、六个伙伴和完整的一百枚成就贴纸。家长面板可以看今天、近七天和完整记录。

任务能否拆得够小、够具体
能否按家里的作息自建任务

en.title: Reward stickers for kids: instant praise or an end-of-week chart?
en.meta: Children aged three to seven respond to what happens right now. Reward stickers work when paired with instant praise and small fixed tasks. Lumi Mission Planet turns brushing, meals and tidying into small missions, free to start.
en.h1: Reward stickers for kids: instant praise or an end-of-week chart?
en.lead: Many families' sticker charts do not last two weeks. The problem is rarely the stickers; it is that the reward comes too late.
en.answer: For ages three to seven, give the response in the moment and use stickers to record the result: instant feedback for every small action, then look at the collection together at the weekend rather than saving every reward for Sunday.
paras: Young children struggle to link Monday's tooth brushing with a reward on Sunday. When the wait is long, the chart becomes a parent's ledger instead of a child's motivation. An instant response makes "I did it" and "someone noticed" happen at the same moment.

Tasks also need to be small and concrete. "Be good" cannot be completed; "finish brushing" or "put the blocks back in the basket" can. Three to five fixed tasks a day are easier to keep than a dozen; if one is too hard, make it smaller rather than taking stickers away.

Lumi Mission Planet turns meals, tooth brushing, sleep, tidy-up and school prep into daily missions. Your child taps for each small win and a buddy character cheers right away. Meals, brushing, sleep and tidy-up missions plus the first stickers in each category are free; one purchase adds school prep, custom missions, all six buddies and the full set of one hundred achievement stickers. A parent dashboard shows today, the last seven days and the full history.
look: An instant response for each step, not only a weekly tally
Whether tasks can be broken down small enough
Whether you can create missions that match your routine
Completion times and history for parents
Ads or pop-ups that interrupt the child
steps: Pick three tasks that happen every day, such as brushing, finishing a meal and tidying toys.
Write each as a single action and respond the moment it is done.
For the first week only add, never subtract: if a task is too hard, make it smaller.
At the weekend, look at the stickers collected together and talk about the easiest task.
Once one is easy, swap in a new task and keep the total at three to five.
rows: Young children struggle to link behaviour with a delayed reward
"Be good" cannot be judged as done
Parents can see which part of the day gets stuck
en.fits: Lumi Mission Planet fits children aged three to seven building daily routines with a parent: instant buddy reactions, achievement stickers and a daily reminder. The core missions are free to start; a one-time purchase adds custom missions and the full sticker set, with no subscription.
faq: Will stickers make my child do things only for the reward?
Keep the focus on the praise in the moment and on finishing; the sticker is just a record. Rotate in new tasks as old ones become easy instead of raising the reward.
Can I set missions to fit our routine?
Yes. Meals, brushing, sleep and tidy-up are built in; custom missions and school prep are part of the one-time unlock.
Will progress be lost on a new phone?
You can export a backup and import it on the new phone.

loc.title: Lần cuối mình làm việc này là khi nào? Cách ghi lại việc nhà theo ngày làm gần nhất
loc.meta: Thay ga giường, tưới cây, thay lõi lọc: những việc lặp lại không cần danh sách việc cần làm, mà cần biết lần cuối là khi nào. Mochi DoneStamp ghi lại bằng một lần chạm, không cần tài khoản.
loc.h1: Lần cuối mình làm việc này là khi nào? Cách ghi lại việc nhà theo ngày làm gần nhất
loc.lead: Có những việc không có hạn chót rõ ràng, nhưng quên quá lâu thì phiền: thay ga giường, vệ sinh máy lọc nước, gọi điện cho bố mẹ.
loc.answer: Với việc lặp lại, hãy ghi lại thời điểm bạn thực sự làm xong thay vì đặt lịch cố định. Lần tiếp theo được tính từ lần cuối, nên làm trễ vài ngày cũng không làm lệch cả chu kỳ.
paras: Danh sách việc cần làm hợp với việc làm một lần. Việc lặp lại thì khác: câu hỏi thật sự là “lần cuối là khi nào”. Nếu chỉ đặt nhắc nhở mỗi ngày 1, bạn sẽ nhận thông báo cả khi vừa làm hôm qua, và dần dần bỏ qua mọi thông báo.

Cách ổn định hơn là ghi lại ngay khi làm xong, rồi để nhịp lặp lại tính từ thời điểm đó. Có việc chỉ cần nhịp gần đúng, ví dụ “khoảng hai tuần”; có việc cần đúng giờ, ví dụ thuốc cho thú cưng. Phân biệt hai loại giúp nhắc nhở chỉ đến khi cần.

Mochi DoneStamp ghi thời điểm bằng một lần chạm, có hoàn tác, và cho phép ghi lùi ngày, sửa hoặc xóa từng lần. Nhịp có thể đặt từ vài phút đến vài năm, nhắc nhở cục bộ có nút Xong và Hoãn, kèm widget trên màn hình chính và màn hình khóa. Dữ liệu cốt lõi nằm trên máy, không cần tài khoản.

Đặt nhịp gần đúng cho việc linh hoạt, nhịp chính xác cho việc cần đúng giờ.

en.title: When did I last do it? Track home chores by the last-done date
en.meta: Changing sheets, watering plants, replacing a filter: repeating chores need the last-done date, not a to-do list. Mochi DoneStamp logs it with one tap, with no account.
en.h1: When did I last do it? Track home chores by the last-done date
en.lead: Some tasks have no clear deadline but become a problem if forgotten too long: changing the sheets, cleaning the water filter, calling your parents.
en.answer: For repeating tasks, record when you actually finished instead of setting a fixed calendar date. The next one is counted from the last time, so doing it a few days late does not throw off the whole rhythm.
paras: To-do lists suit one-off tasks. Repeating tasks are different: the real question is "when was the last time?". A reminder on the 1st of every month fires even if you did it yesterday, and soon you ignore every reminder.

A steadier method is to log the moment you finish and let the rhythm restart from there. Some tasks only need an approximate rhythm, such as "about every two weeks"; others need an exact one, such as a pet's medication. Separating the two means reminders arrive only when needed.

Mochi DoneStamp logs the time with one tap, with Undo, and lets you backdate, edit or delete any occurrence. Rhythms range from minutes to years, local reminders come with Done and Snooze actions, and there are Home and Lock Screen widgets. Core data stays on the device, with no account.
look: One-tap logging of the moment you finish
Next due time counted from the real last time, not a fixed calendar
Backdating for when you forgot to tap
Widgets for a glance without opening the app
Account, ads and subscription
steps: List five repeating tasks you tend to forget, such as sheets, plants and photo backups.
For each, log the last time you remember, backdating if needed.
Use an approximate rhythm for flexible tasks and an exact one for time-critical ones.
Each time you finish, tap once on the spot.
After a month, look at the real gaps between occurrences and adjust the rhythm.
rows: Repeating tasks need the last date, not a permanent tick
Reminders at the right time instead of useless ones
One missed tap does not spoil the data
en.fits: Mochi DoneStamp fits repeating household and life tasks where you just need to know when you last did them. Free with one active event and unlimited history; a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited events, with no subscription.
faq: How is it different from a to-do app?
A to-do app ticks a task off and forgets it. Mochi DoneStamp keeps every occurrence and counts the next one from the last.
What if I forget to tap?
You can backdate, edit or delete any occurrence.
Do I need an account?
No. No account, ads or tracking; core data stays on the device.

loc.h1: تعلّم 44 لغة: كيف تبدأ لغة جديدة بخمس كلمات في اليوم؟
loc.lead: معظم من يبدأ لغة جديدة لا يتوقف لأن اللغة صعبة، بل لأن الجلسة اليومية أطول مما يحتمل يومه.
loc.answer: اختر لغة واحدة ومسارًا واحدًا مرتبطًا بحياتك، مثل السفر أو العمل، وابدأ بخمس كلمات في اليوم. الاستمرار ثلاثين يومًا يفيد أكثر من جلسة طويلة واحدة ثم انقطاع.
paras: وجود 44 لغة لا يعني أن تتعلم أكثر من لغة في البداية. القرار الأهم هو لماذا تتعلم: رحلة قادمة، أو مقابلة عمل، أو التحدث مع زملاء. المسار المرتبط بسبب حقيقي يجعل الكلمات تُستخدم بسرعة، وما يُستخدم يبقى.
خمس كلمات قد تبدو قليلة، لكنها تصبح نحو 150 كلمة في شهر إذا لم تنقطع. والأهم أن الجلسة القصيرة يمكن إكمالها حتى في يوم مزدحم، فلا تنكسر السلسلة عند أول أسبوع صعب.

en.title: Learning one of 44 languages: how to start with five words a day
en.meta: Picking a language from 44 is easier than sticking with it. Start with five words in one minute a day on a path that fits your life. Wordmate Lite is free to start and works offline.
en.h1: Learning one of 44 languages: how to start with five words a day
en.lead: Most people who start a new language do not quit because it is hard, but because the daily session is longer than their day allows.
en.answer: Choose one language and one path tied to your life, such as travel or work, and start with five words a day. Thirty unbroken days do more than one long session followed by a gap.
paras: Having 44 languages does not mean learning several at first. The key decision is why you are learning: an upcoming trip, a job interview, talking with colleagues. A path tied to a real reason puts words to use quickly, and words you use stay.

Five words can sound small, but it becomes about 150 words in a month if you do not stop. More importantly, a short session can be finished even on a busy day, so the streak survives the first hard week.

Wordmate Lite offers a five-word session in about a minute, with 44 learning languages and 14 life paths including travel, business, exams and daily life, at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels. You can hear any word read aloud by the system voice and save the words worth keeping.

Paths tied to your reason for learning, not only general lists
Pronunciation for every word
A clear view of the words you learned today
Whether an account or subscription is needed
steps: Choose just one language for the first thirty days.
Choose one path tied to a real reason, such as travel or work.
Set a daily goal of five words and do not raise it in week one.
Listen to each word and repeat it out loud.
After a month, raise the goal to ten words if the streak held.
rows: A minute or half an hour
A path tied to your life
Words you use stay in memory
You recognise a word when you hear it, not only when you read it
en.fits: Wordmate Lite fits people who have started a language more than once and stopped, and want a short daily habit they can keep. Free to start, with the full content unlocked by one purchase, no subscription.
faq: Can I learn several languages at once?
Progress is tracked per language, but starting with one language for a month makes the habit stick.
Does it work offline?
Yes, you can learn without a connection.
Can I raise the daily goal?
Yes, you can pick 5, 10, 15 or 20 words a day.

loc.title: صانع السيرة الذاتية وفحص ATS: ما الذي تصلحه قبل التقديم؟
loc.meta: كثير من بوابات التوظيف تقرأ السيرة الذاتية آليًا قبل أن يراها إنسان. عمود واحد، نص قابل للتحديد، وعناوين قياسية. CV Desk يبني السيرة ويعطي درجة ATS على جهازك، دون حساب ودون اشتراك.
loc.h1: صانع السيرة الذاتية وفحص ATS: ما الذي تصلحه قبل التقديم؟
loc.lead: السيرة الذاتية الجميلة قد تُرفض قبل أن يقرأها أحد، لأن نظام تتبع المتقدمين لم يستطع قراءتها.
loc.answer: اجعل السيرة في عمود واحد بنص حقيقي قابل للتحديد، واستخدم عناوين قياسية مثل الخبرة والتعليم والمهارات، وضع الكلمات المفتاحية من إعلان الوظيفة كما هي. ثم افحص النتيجة قبل الإرسال.
paras: أنظمة تتبع المتقدمين (ATS) تحوّل ملفك إلى نص ثم توزعه على حقول. الجداول والأعمدة المتعددة والنص داخل الصور قد تختلط عند التحويل، فيظهر اسم الشركة في خانة المهارات أو يختفي تاريخ العمل تمامًا.

الكلمات المفتاحية لا تعني حشو السيرة بالمصطلحات. المقصود أن تستخدم نفس التسمية الموجودة في الإعلان: إذا طلب الإعلان إدارة المشاريع فلا تكتب فقط تنسيق المهام. وعدّل السيرة لكل وظيفة بدل إرسال نسخة واحدة للجميع.

يبني CV Desk السيرة على iPhone ويعطي درجة ATS تقديرية من 0 إلى 100 على الجهاز مع إصلاحات واضحة، ويصدّر ملف PDF بعمود واحد ونص قابل للتحديد، وملف Word قابلًا للتعديل. يمكنك إنشاء عدة نسخ، واحدة لكل وظيفة. السيرة لا تغادر جهازك.

لا. هي تقدير على الجهاز لتحسين قابلية القراءة وتغطية الكلمات المفتاحية، وكل شركة تستخدم نظامها الخاص.

لا. السيرة تبقى على جهازك، ولا حاجة إلى حساب.

en.title: Resume maker with an ATS check: what to fix before you apply
en.meta: Many job portals read your resume by machine before a person sees it. Use one column, selectable text and standard headings. CV Desk builds the resume and gives an ATS score on your device, with no account and no subscription.
en.h1: Resume maker with an ATS check: what to fix before you apply
en.lead: A good-looking resume can be rejected before anyone reads it, because the applicant tracking system could not parse it.
en.answer: Keep the resume in one column with real, selectable text, use standard headings such as Experience, Education and Skills, and use the keywords from the job ad as written. Then check the result before you send it.
paras: Applicant tracking systems turn your file into text and sort it into fields. Tables, multiple columns and text inside images can get scrambled in that conversion, so a company name lands in Skills or a work date disappears.

Keywords do not mean stuffing the resume with jargon. It means using the same wording as the ad: if it asks for project management, do not only write task coordination. Tailor the resume for each role instead of sending one version everywhere.

CV Desk builds the resume on iPhone and gives an on-device ATS estimate from 0 to 100 with clear fixes, then exports a single-column PDF with selectable text and an editable Word file. You can keep several resumes, one per job. Your resume never leaves the device.
look: PDF export with selectable text, not an image
One-column layout with standard headings
A check that explains what to fix, not just a number
An editable Word version when you need it
A watermark or surprise subscription at export
steps: Copy the job ad and pick its six to eight most important keywords.
Write experience as actions and measurable results under standard headings.
Remove tables, columns and text inside images.
Run the check and apply the suggested fixes one by one.
Export the PDF and confirm you can select and copy the text before sending.
rows: Columns can scramble when the file becomes text

The system matches words before it reads meaning
en.fits: CV Desk fits anyone who wants to build an ATS-safe resume entirely on iPhone, with an on-device check and PDF and Word export. Build and preview without a purchase; a one-time unlock exports with no watermark, with no subscription and no ads.
faq: Is the app's ATS score the same as the employer's?
No. It is an on-device estimate to improve parse safety and keyword coverage; each employer uses its own system.
Should I add a photo?
The header photo is optional and off by default. Follow what the ad or country you apply in expects.
Is my resume uploaded?
No. It stays on your device and no account is needed.

en.title: Offline document scanner: why it matters when you scan IDs and contracts
en.meta: IDs, contracts and payslips do not need to go to a server to become a PDF. ScanTo Pro scans and reads text on the iPhone itself and works in airplane mode. Free to start, with a one-time unlock and no subscription.
en.h1: Offline document scanner: why it matters when you scan IDs and contracts
en.lead: Many scanner apps send pages to the cloud to read the text. That is unnecessary when the document is your ID or your contract.
en.answer: Choose a scanner that reads text on the device and works in airplane mode, and export a password-protected PDF when you share. That way your data leaves the phone only when you send it.
paras: The simplest test is airplane mode: open the app offline and scan a page. If scanning and text recognition work as usual, the processing happens on the device. If it stops, part of it needs a server.

Scanning on-device does not remove the need for protection when sharing. When you send a copy of an ID or contract, it helps to encrypt the PDF with a password that you send through a different channel.

ScanTo Pro turns paper into clean PDFs, reads the text on iPhone so you can search inside documents later, and auto-sorts scans into categories such as Receipts, IDs and Contracts. You can lock the app with Face ID; there is no account, cloud or tracking, and it works the same in airplane mode.

Scan on a dark surface with even light.
Check the recognised text and copy or export it if you need it.
When sharing, export a password PDF and send the password in a separate message.
Turn on the app lock if others sometimes use your phone.

loc.lead: Masalah trip bareng jarang soal tujuan. Masalahnya, jam kereta ada di satu chat, alamat hotel di chat lain, dan tidak ada yang yakin rencana terakhir yang mana.

en.title: Planning a trip with friends: one itinerary everyone can follow
en.meta: Group trips get messy when the plan is scattered across chats. One daily itinerary with times, tickets and hotels tells everyone where to be. TripBee Lite is free for one trip.
en.h1: Planning a trip with friends: one itinerary everyone can follow
en.lead: Group trips rarely go wrong over the destination. They go wrong when train times are in one chat, the hotel address in another, and no one is sure which plan is current.
en.answer: Pick one person to hold the plan, lay out each day with times, places and ticket numbers in one place, and share only that version. Changes go into the plan, not only into the group chat.
paras: Group chats are good for discussion but poor as an archive. After a hundred messages, key details such as booking codes or check-in times are buried. A plan kept apart from the chat lets everyone see the same version.

A useful itinerary does not have to be packed. For a group, leave gaps between activities, because gathering always takes longer than expected. Write a clear meeting point and time, not just a place name.

TripBee Lite is built around one active trip: shape each day on a timeline, keep flight and hotel details together, and add notes, reminders and ticket references. The free app saves one journey; a single Premium purchase unlocks unlimited journeys, trip sharing, full backup and the smart packing list.

Account, ads and subscription

Lay out each day with times, meeting points and gaps between activities.
Add hotel booking codes and ticket numbers to the same plan.
Share the plan with the group and ask everyone to refer to it.
When something changes, update the plan first, then tell the group.

Trip sharing is part of the Premium purchase. The free version saves and edits one journey.

en.title: Better AI prompts start with complete context, not longer instructions
en.meta: AI answers often go wrong because the context is incomplete, not because the prompt is short. Combine screenshots, PDFs and notes into one brief and check the facts before sending. AI Brief works on-device, with no ads.
en.h1: Better AI prompts start with complete context, not longer instructions
en.lead: Many people rewrite a prompt again and again, but the answer still misses, because the AI never saw the documents they saw.
en.answer: Give the prompt three parts: the goal, checked context from the real files, and the answer format you want. The part usually missing is context, so gather it into one brief before pasting it into the chat.
paras: When context is scattered across screenshots, PDFs and copied text, we tend to send the AI only part of it and let it guess the rest. The result sounds confident but uses wrong or outdated information.
Before sending, check where the key facts come from, which ones conflict, and whether there is personal data that should not go out. A minute here saves several rounds of follow-up questions.

AI Brief combines screenshots, PDFs, files, text, notes and links into one brief, using Apple frameworks on the device for OCR, PDF reading, duplicate checks and privacy detection. Every fact keeps its source and confidence, and you copy the finished brief into any AI chat in one tap.

The source of each fact visible before sending
Detected personal details you keep, replace or remove yourself
Works with any AI chat, not tied to one service
Ads, tracking and content upload
steps: Write the goal in one sentence: what you want the AI to do.
Gather the related screenshots, PDFs and notes into one brief.
Check conflicting facts and add context where needed.
Keep, replace or remove each personal detail.
State the answer format, then copy the brief into the AI chat.

en.fits: AI Brief fits people who use AI on real work with supporting files and want to send checked context in one go. No ads or tracking, and no subscription; there is a one-time unlock.
faq: Does AI Brief send my files to an AI itself?
No. You copy the checked brief and paste it into the AI chat yourself.
Is personal data removed automatically?
No. Detected items are shown so you can keep, replace or remove each one, and AI Brief never promises anonymity.
Which AI can I use it with?
The brief is copyable text, so it works with any AI chat.

loc.meta: Plodné okno je odhad z dĺžky vašich cyklov, nie istota. Čím viac cyklov zaznamenáte, tým presnejší odhad. Cyca uchováva údaje len v iPhone, bez účtu. Nie je to zdravotnícka pomôcka ani antikoncepcia.
loc.h1: Plodnosť a plodné dni: ako ich aplikácie na cyklus odhadujú a kde sú hranice
loc.lead: Kalendár plodných dní vyzerá presne, ale za ním je výpočet z vašich doterajších cyklov. Je dobré vedieť, z čoho vychádza.
loc.answer: Aplikácia odhaduje ovuláciu podľa dĺžky vašich predchádzajúcich cyklov a okolo nej vyznačí plodné okno približne šiestich dní. Pri pravidelnom cykle je odhad užitočný na plánovanie, nie je však antikoncepciou ani lekárskou diagnózou.
paras: Ovulácia nastáva zvyčajne približne dva týždne pred ďalšou menštruáciou, nie nutne v polovici cyklu. Preto má zmysel zaznamenávať skutočný začiatok každej menštruácie: odhad sa spresňuje až s niekoľkými cyklami.
Ak sú vaše cykly nepravidelné, po pôrode, pri dojčení alebo pri zmene liekov, odhad z kalendára je menej spoľahlivý. Vtedy je vhodné poradiť sa s lekárom, nie spoliehať sa len na aplikáciu.

Cyca zaznamenáva menštruáciu, príznaky, náladu a poznámky jedným ťuknutím a učí sa váš rytmus. Predpoveď ďalšej menštruácie, plodného okna a ovulácie sa prispôsobuje každému záznamu. Údaje zostávajú v iPhone, bez účtu, bez cloudu a bez sledovania, a aplikácia funguje úplne offline.

en.title: Fertility and fertile days: how cycle apps estimate them, and their limits
en.meta: The fertile window is an estimate from your cycle lengths, not a certainty. The more cycles you log, the better the estimate. Cyca keeps data on your iPhone with no account. It is not a medical device or contraception.
en.h1: Fertility and fertile days: how cycle apps estimate them, and their limits
en.lead: A fertile-day calendar looks precise, but behind it is a calculation from your past cycles. It helps to know what it is based on.
en.answer: The app estimates ovulation from the length of your previous cycles and marks a fertile window of roughly six days around it. With a regular cycle the estimate is useful for planning, but it is not contraception or a medical diagnosis.
paras: Ovulation usually happens about two weeks before the next period, not necessarily mid-cycle. That is why it is worth logging the real start of each period: the estimate only sharpens after several cycles.

If your cycles are irregular, or after childbirth, while breastfeeding or with a change in medication, a calendar estimate is less reliable. In those cases it is wise to talk to a doctor rather than rely on an app alone.

Cyca logs your period, symptoms, mood and notes in a tap and learns your rhythm. Predictions for the next period, fertile window and ovulation adapt with every entry. Data stays on your iPhone, with no account, cloud or tracking, and the app works fully offline.

loc.lead: 很多人记了账，月底还是不知道钱花到哪里去了。问题不在记录，而在付款那一刻没有停一下。
loc.answer: 付款前做两件事：把价格换算成自己要工作几个小时，再给这笔消费贴上“需要、想要、冲动”其中一个标签。坚持一个月，就能看出哪一类在悄悄吃掉预算。

标签的作用在于事后回看。单看金额，很难分辨是生活必需还是一时冲动；有了标签，月底就能直接看到冲动消费占了多少，下个月只需要针对这一类调整。

en.title: Rational spending: label need, want or impulse before you pay
en.meta: Rational spending is not about not spending; it is about spending clearly. Convert the price into work hours before paying, then label it need, want or impulse. HoursTag Lite keeps data on your device with no account.
en.h1: Rational spending: label need, want or impulse before you pay
en.lead: Many people track spending and still do not know where the money went by month end. The problem is not the record; it is not pausing at the moment of payment.
en.answer: Before paying, do two things: convert the price into hours of your own work, and label the purchase as need, want or impulse. After a month you can see which category is quietly eating the budget.
paras: A price is an abstract number; work hours are real life. Something that looks cheap feels different once it becomes six hours of work. This step is not about forbidding purchases but about deciding with a clear head.

Labels matter when you look back. Amounts alone do not show what was essential and what was a whim; with labels, at month end you can see how much went on impulse and adjust just that category next month.

HoursTag Lite converts prices into work time using your real take-home hourly value, labels each purchase as need, want or impulse, shows your value pattern, and can work out how many hours a goal costs and track progress. It has a widget and Apple Watch support, and data stays on the device with no account or tracking.

loc.answer: 充電中だけ常時点灯にするか、バッテリー残量の下限を決めて点灯させるかを選び、有機 EL 画面ならピクセルを少しずつずらす機能と夜の暗い表示を使います。これで画面とバッテリーへの負担を抑えられます。

有機 EL の iPhone で同じ数字を長時間表示すると、焼き付きが気になります。表示位置を少しずつずらす、何もしていないときは細部を控えめにする、夜は黒背景に暗い赤で表示する、といった工夫が負担を減らします。寝室では明るさの点でも夜の表示が役立ちます。
Stay Clock は iPhone と iPad を常時表示の卓上時計にするアプリです。充電を理解した点灯設定、有機 EL 向けのパネルケア、夜用の暗い赤の表示に加え、選んだ文字盤がスタンバイ、ロック画面とホーム画面のウィジェット、Apple Watch でも同じ見た目になります。アカウント、広告、追跡、通信はありません。

en.meta: If you turn a spare iPad or a charging iPhone into a flip clock, decide three things first: always-on behaviour, battery, and OLED burn-in care. Stay Clock includes one free face and needs no account.
en.h1: Running a flip clock on iPhone or iPad all day: what to set first
en.lead: A flip-style clock looks good and reads well from across the room. If it stays on all day, though, a few settings matter.
en.answer: Choose whether the screen stays on only while charging or with a battery floor, and on OLED screens use gentle pixel shifting and a dim night face. That keeps the load on the screen and battery low.
paras: iPhones and iPads normally turn the screen off after a while. To use one as a clock, it helps to have a rule such as staying on while charging, or returning to normal when the battery drops below a set level.

Showing the same digits for hours on an OLED iPhone raises burn-in concerns. Shifting the display slightly over time, softening details when idle and using a dim red face on black at night reduce the load, and the night face also helps with brightness in the bedroom.

Stay Clock turns iPhone and iPad into an always-on desk clock. It offers charging-aware Keep Awake, Panel Care for OLED screens and a dim red night face, and the face you pick looks the same in StandBy, on Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets and on Apple Watch. No account, ads, tracking or network.

Burn-in care for OLED screens

Portrait, landscape and large iPad layouts
Account, ads and network use

Set Keep Awake to charging only, or always on with a battery floor.
On an OLED iPhone, turn on Panel Care.
In the bedroom, set the night schedule and the dim red face.
Pick the date or calendar view for each face and check it reads from a distance.

en.title: Block apps or Screen Time limits: which actually keeps you off your phone?
en.meta: iPhone Screen Time limits are easy to skip with a tap. A timed blocking session with a pause before cancelling works differently. LockHour Pro blocks distracting apps and unlocks them automatically, with no account and no subscription.
en.h1: Block apps or Screen Time limits: which actually keeps you off your phone?
en.lead: Many people set Screen Time limits and ignore them the same day. The problem is not willpower; it is that skipping is easier than sticking.
en.answer: Screen Time limits suit monitoring daily use. When you need a focused hour for work, study or sleep, a timed blocking session works better, especially when stopping early requires a short wait and a confirmation.
paras: A daily limit tells you when you have gone over, but it usually appears mid-scroll and can be dismissed with one tap. So it is better at showing where time goes than at stopping it.

A blocking session starts before the distraction does: you pick the apps and the length, they are shielded during the session and unlock automatically when it ends. When stopping early takes a cooldown and confirmation, going back to the app becomes a deliberate choice rather than a reflex.

LockHour Pro offers ready focus modes: Quick Focus, Deep Work, Study Mode with Pomodoro-style cycles and breaks, Sleep Wind Down, Morning Reset, or a custom length. Hard Mode adds a cooldown and confirmation before stopping early, and you see today's focused time, weekly charts and streaks, with widgets and a Dynamic Island countdown.

Friction before stopping early, not an instant ignore button
Separate modes for work, study, sleep and mornings
Stats that show reclaimed focus time
Account, ads or subscription
steps: Review a week of Screen Time and pick the two or three most distracting apps.
Choose a fixed daily focus time, such as the first hour of work or study.
Start a blocking session for those apps for that hour.
Turn on Hard Mode if you often stop sessions early.
Add a bedtime session to stop late-night scrolling, and check your streak at the weekend.
rows: Blocking ahead stops the start rather than the middle
A tap or a wait and confirmation
A little friction turns habit into a decision
Each tool has a different job
en.fits: LockHour Pro fits people who want set hours of focus for work, study or sleep without relying on willpower. One purchase unlocks everything, with no subscription, account or ads.

No; Screen Time is useful for seeing usage, and LockHour Pro is for set focus sessions.

Yes. In Hard Mode, stopping is preceded by a cooldown and confirmation.

en.h1: Passport photo at home in Taiwan: size, background and printing done right
en.lead: Passport photos are usually rejected not because they look bad, but because the head is too large or too small, the background has shadows, or the print is the wrong size.
en.answer: Check the latest photo specification from the Bureau of Consular Affairs, shoot face-on in natural light in front of a white wall, align the top of the head, eyes and chin with crop guides, and lay the photo out on a print sheet. The issuing agency's rules always take precedence.
paras: Passport photos are about proportion: the photo size is fixed, and so is how much of it the head should fill. The common mistake when cropping yourself is centring the face without controlling head size. A tool with head-top, eye-line and chin guides is far more accurate than judging by eye.

Background and light affect approval too. Standing a step away from the wall reduces shadows behind you, and facing a window gives more even light than a ceiling lamp. Keep edits to light brightness and contrast changes; do not alter features or skin tone.

Snapport Lite includes 35 common presets for 28 countries and regions, including 35×45 mm, plus custom sizes in millimetres, inches or pixels. On-device face detection shows head-top, eye-line and chin guides, the background can be kept or switched to white or another colour, and you can lay out several copies on 4×6 in, A4 or Letter paper with cut guides. Photos are processed on the phone and never uploaded.

en.title: Network check on iPhone: how to read Wi-Fi, DNS and internet results
en.meta: A slow or dropped connection can come from Wi-Fi, DNS or the provider. Check each layer to know whether to restart the router or call support. WiFi Aid Lite: one full check needs no purchase, with no ads.
en.h1: Network check on iPhone: how to read Wi-Fi, DNS and internet results
en.lead: "The network is broken" can mean three different things. Knowing which layer fails lets you fix the right thing instead of restarting everything.
en.answer: Check in order: is the iPhone well connected to Wi-Fi, does DNS resolve domain names, and does the wider internet respond. The first layer that fails is the one to fix.
paras: If Wi-Fi is weak or unstable, the cause is usually distance to the router or interference. If Wi-Fi is fine but DNS fails, websites will not open even though you are connected, and changing DNS or restarting the router often helps. If both are fine but the internet does not respond, the provider's line is the likely cause.

A single result can mislead when the connection comes and goes. Taking more samples over a few minutes shows whether the connection varies, and checking one site separately tells you whether that site or the whole internet is down.

WiFi Aid Lite runs Wi-Fi, DNS and internet checks in one tap, offers a Deep Check for more evidence and stability samples, and can check a specific website. Evidence covers DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, HTTP, direct IP, IPv4 and IPv6. Check history is stored only on the device.
look: Separate Wi-Fi, DNS and internet results
Several samples to show whether the connection varies
A check for one specific website
History to compare before and after a fix
Account, ads and tracking
steps: Stand near the router and run one full check.
Find the first layer that fails: Wi-Fi, DNS or internet.
If it is Wi-Fi, move or restart the router; if it is DNS, try another DNS.
If only one site fails, check that site alone before calling the provider.
If the internet still does not respond, call support and read them the results.

Usually DNS or the internet line. Checking layer by layer shows which one fails.

loc.h1: Плёночная камера на iPhone: снимать сразу с эффектом или добавлять потом?

loc.answer: Снимайте с живым предпросмотром, когда важна атмосфера момента и вы хотите сразу видеть итог; обрабатывайте потом, когда важна точность цвета и кожи. Удобнее всего приложение, которое умеет и то и другое.

Обработка после съёмки оставляет больше свободы. Один и тот же кадр можно попробовать в нескольких видах, а затем поправить экспозицию, кривые и цвет. Для портретов это особенно важно: сильный плёночный фильтр легко делает кожу серой или оранжевой.

PhotoCream Pro снимает с живым предпросмотром более чем 100 видов — ретро, кино, моментальные снимки, монохром — с зерном, ореолом, засветками и виньеткой. Затем фото можно доработать: экспозиция, контраст, кривые, HSL, раздельное тонирование и мягкая обработка кожи, сохраняющая резкость глаз и волос. Всё обрабатывается на устройстве, ничего не загружается.

en.title: Film camera app on iPhone: shoot with the look, or add it later?
en.meta: You can get a film look two ways: shoot with a live filter preview or edit finished photos. Here is when each works better. PhotoCream Pro processes everything on-device, with no subscription.
en.h1: Film camera app on iPhone: shoot with the look, or add it later?
en.lead: Film camera apps promise the same thing but work differently: some apply the look as you shoot, others only when you edit.
en.answer: Shoot with a live preview when the mood of the moment matters and you want to see the result right away; edit later when accurate colour and skin matter. The most convenient option is an app that does both.
paras: A live preview changes how you shoot: you see grain, glow and colour before pressing the shutter and frame for that look. That is closer to real film, where the choice is made in advance.

Editing afterwards gives more freedom. You can try one frame in several looks, then adjust exposure, curves and colour. For portraits this matters most: a heavy film filter can easily turn skin grey or orange.

PhotoCream Pro shoots with a live preview of 100+ looks across retro, cinema, instant and mono, with grain, halation, light leaks and vignette. You can then refine the photo with exposure, contrast, curves, HSL, split toning and frequency-separation skin smoothing that keeps eyes and hair sharp. Everything is processed on the device; nothing is uploaded.

Uploads, ads and subscription

Shoot with the live preview, arranging light and framing for that look.
For portraits, check skin tone and soften the effect if needed.
Adjust exposure and curves if the look made the frame too dark.
Save your setting and use it for the whole series.

Personal photos never leave the phone

Yes. Besides shooting with the preview, you can edit photos from your library.

No. All processing happens on the device and no account is needed.

No. Free download and a one-time unlock for the premium packs.

en.title: Ten minutes of math practice a day: start with pictures, then target weak spots
en.meta: Young children understand numbers through pictures before digits. Practise briefly every day and repeat only what is not yet solid. Lumi Math Planet uses picture questions read aloud, with no ads and no subscription.
en.h1: Ten minutes of math practice a day: start with pictures, then target weak spots
en.lead: Long worksheets often end in boredom. Young children learn numbers better when they can see them and practise briefly every day.
en.answer: Practise about ten minutes a day with picture-based questions such as dice, ten-frames and number lines before plain digits, and once a week check which skill is still missed often so you can repeat just that one.
paras: A child who cannot yet read well understands "eight is more than five" faster when they see eight dots beside five. Pictures build number sense, which is the foundation for addition and subtraction more than memorising.

Consistency beats length. Ten minutes every day beats an hour at the weekend, and not scolding wrong answers keeps children willing to try. The most helpful thing a parent can do is notice which topic keeps going wrong and practise just that.

Lumi Math Planet has 40+ question types covering counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, time and money. Every question is visual and read aloud, and levels adjust automatically. The Parent Zone shows learning across five skill domains, spots weak areas and prints worksheets with answer keys. Questions and voice come in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

Start with picture questions your child can do, so they begin confident.
Sit alongside in the first week and praise effort more than speed.
Each week, check the skills still missed often and repeat just those.
Print a worksheet on the same topic to see whether the understanding holds off-screen.

Yes, parents can print worksheets with answer keys.

en.title: Cleaning up iPhone storage: check photos and videos first
en.meta: Before deleting apps or resetting the phone, see what is actually using the space; usually it is duplicate photos, screenshots and large videos. PicClear Pro scans on-device and lets you review before anything is deleted, with no subscription.
en.h1: Cleaning up iPhone storage: check photos and videos first
en.lead: Many people start a cleanup by deleting apps, but recover less space than expected, because the biggest share is in the photo library.
en.answer: Open Settings > General > iPhone Storage to see what uses the most space. If it is Photos, start with large videos, duplicates and old screenshots, which you can remove with almost no loss of memories.
paras: A handful of videos can outweigh thousands of photos. Near-identical burst shots and screenshots you no longer need also pile up quietly. Starting with these groups recovers the most space in the least time.

The risk is deleting the wrong thing. You should see previews before deleting, keep the best shot in each group and protect your favourites. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos and can be recovered for a limited time; to get the space back immediately, empty that folder too.

PicClear Pro scans the photo library on the device and groups duplicates, similar photos, screenshots, blurry shots, large videos and large photos. It suggests the best shot to keep in each group, never auto-selects Favourites and deletes nothing until you confirm. Photos are not uploaded, no account is needed and it works fully offline.
look: Previews before every deletion
A suggested best shot to keep among similar photos
Favourites protected from automatic selection
On-device scanning with no uploads
Ads and subscription
steps: Open iPhone Storage to see how much space Photos uses.
Start with large videos and decide clip by clip.
Remove duplicates and keep the best shot in each similar group.
Delete old screenshots you no longer need.
Empty Recently Deleted once you are sure, so the space really comes back.
rows: A few clips can outweigh thousands of photos
Space back without losing the moment
Space does not return until it is emptied
en.fits: PicClear Pro fits people whose iPhone is full because of the photo library and who want to review everything before deleting. Scanning and previews are free; deleting is unlocked with a one-time purchase, with no subscription and no ads.
faq: Can I recover deleted photos?
Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos and can be recovered for a limited time.
Are my photos sent anywhere?
No. All analysis happens on the device, no account is needed and it works offline.
Is the app in Thai?
The interface is not yet in Thai, but the workflow is built on previews and a clear confirm step.

loc.title: toeic 990：高分段卡住時，先找出最拖分的 3 項技能
loc.meta: 分數停在高分段上不去，多半不是題目做得不夠多，而是少數幾項技能一直在扣分。先用短診斷找出最弱的 3 項，每天只練一項，第 30 天同項目複測，比再刷一本題庫更快看出差別。
loc.h1: toeic 990：卡在高分段，先補最拖分的 3 項
loc.lead: 題目刷了一輪又一輪，分數卻一直停在同一段，通常是同幾項技能在反覆失分。
loc.answer: 想往 990 推，先別再隨機刷題：用短時間診斷找出最弱的 3 項技能，排出先修哪一項，每天集中練一項，第 30 天用同樣的技能複測、和第 1 天並排比較，才知道時間有沒有花在對的地方。
paras: 搜尋 toeic 990 的人，多半已經不是初學者，而是卡在高分段、不知道剩下的分數掉在哪裡。到這個階段，平均地再多做幾回模擬，很難讓分數再動；真正拖分的往往是少數幾項技能，例如文法題的作答速度、長篇閱讀的時間分配，或某一類聽力題型。
Aim990 先用約 8 分鐘、約 20 題的文法、聽力與閱讀診斷，估算你的練習級距，找出最弱的 3 項技能，寫成一份處方：先修哪一項、為什麼失分、大概要花多久。之後每天只練一項處方技能，分成診斷、修復、驗證三個階段，不用無止盡地隨機刷題。
第 30 天重新測同樣的技能，和第 1 天的紀錄並排比較；學習證據紀錄會逐項記下正確率與作答節奏。考前 1、3、7、14 天還有緊急模式。沒有帳號、不用登入，學習紀錄只留在你的裝置上，每天的練習可離線使用。顯示的級距是非官方估算，不代表分數保證。
look: 能不能先診斷，再告訴你該先補哪一項
練習是不是依你自己的作答紀錄排，而不是隨機出題
有沒有逐項記錄正確率與作答節奏
能不能在固定天數後用同樣的技能複測、和起點比較
考前幾天有沒有濃縮的衝刺安排
steps: 先做一次約 8 分鐘的診斷，看最弱的 3 項技能是哪些。
照處方的順序，從第一項開始，每天只練這一項。
每項都走完診斷、修復、驗證三個階段再換下一項。
用弱點雷達看前 3 項修復目標有沒有變。
第 30 天複測同樣的技能，和第 1 天的紀錄並排比較。

高分段常是速度不夠，不是不會
時間分配錯了，後面的題目來不及做
裝置內語音的聽寫與跟讀
聽寫看得出是哪幾個字沒聽到
loc.fits: Aim990 適合已經在準備、但分數卡住的人：8 分鐘診斷找出最弱的 3 項技能，每天集中練一項，第 30 天複測並排比較；考前 1、3、7、14 天有緊急模式，Apple Watch 也能快速複習。所有練習內容為原創的非官方教材，不使用官方試題。
faq: 高分段一直卡住，多做模擬考有用嗎？
到高分段，平均地多做幾回很難再推動分數；先找出反覆失分的那幾項技能，集中補，比較容易看出差別。
每天要練多久？
Aim990 每天只練一項處方技能，分成診斷、修復、驗證三個階段，練習可離線使用，通勤或午休的零碎時間也能做。
Aim990 和 ETS 有關係嗎？
沒有。TOEIC 是 ETS 的註冊商標；Aim990 與 ETS 沒有任何隸屬、贊助或認可關係，練習內容都是原創的非官方教材，顯示的級距為非官方估算，並不保證分數。

en.title: TOEIC 990: stuck at a high score, fix your three weakest skills first
en.meta: When your score stalls near the top, more practice sets rarely move it; a few skills keep costing you points. Find your three weakest with a short diagnosis, drill one a day, and recheck the same skills on Day 30.
en.h1: TOEIC 990: stuck near the top, fix the three skills costing you points
en.lead: Round after round of practice and the score stays in the same band. Usually the same few skills keep losing points.
en.answer: To push toward 990, stop drilling at random: find your three weakest skills with a short diagnosis, decide which to fix first, drill one a day, then recheck the same skills on Day 30 next to your Day 1 record to see whether the time went to the right place.
paras: Most people searching for TOEIC 990 are past the basics and stuck at a high score, unsure where the remaining points go. At this stage another set of mock tests rarely moves the score; the drag is usually a few skills, such as grammar speed, pacing on long reading passages, or one type of listening question.

Aim990 starts with a diagnosis of about 20 grammar, listening and reading questions in about 8 minutes, estimates your practice band, and finds your three weakest skills. It writes them up as a prescription: which to fix first, why you lose points, and roughly how long it takes. Each day you drill one prescribed skill through diagnose, repair and verify stages instead of endless random sets.

On Day 30 you retest the same skills and compare side by side with Day 1; the learning evidence log records accuracy and pace for each skill. An emergency mode covers 1, 3, 7 and 14 days before the test. There is no account and no sign-in, your records stay on your device, and daily practice works offline. The band shown is an unofficial estimate, not a score guarantee.
look: Whether it diagnoses first and tells you what to fix first
Whether practice follows your own answer history instead of random questions
Whether accuracy and pace are logged per skill
Whether you can retest the same skills after a set number of days and compare with your start
Whether there is a condensed plan for the last days before the test
steps: Take the roughly 8-minute diagnosis and see your three weakest skills.
Follow the prescription order and drill only the first skill each day.
Take each skill through diagnose, repair and verify before moving on.
Check the weakness radar to see whether your top three repair targets change.
Retest the same skills on Day 30 and compare side by side with Day 1.
rows: At high scores the issue is often speed, not knowledge
Bad pacing leaves the last questions unanswered
Dictation and shadowing with on-device speech
Dictation shows exactly which words you missed
en.fits: Aim990 fits people already preparing whose score has stalled: an 8-minute diagnosis of your three weakest skills, one focused drill a day, and a Day 30 recheck side by side with Day 1; an emergency mode for 1, 3, 7 and 14 days out, and quick review on Apple Watch. All practice content is original and unofficial, with no official test questions.
faq: Do more mock tests help when I am stuck at a high score?
Near the top, more sets rarely move the score; finding the few skills that keep losing points and fixing them is more likely to show a difference.
How long should I practise each day?
Aim990 drills one prescribed skill a day through diagnose, repair and verify stages, and practice works offline, so a commute or lunch break is enough.
Is Aim990 related to ETS?

No. TOEIC is a registered trademark of ETS; Aim990 is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by ETS. All practice content is original and unofficial, and the band shown is an unofficial estimate that does not guarantee a score.

loc.title: 日常會話：背了單字還是開不了口，改用完整句子按情境練
loc.meta: 日常會話卡住，多半不是單字不夠，而是沒練過整句和對方的回應。按點餐、購物、交通、看診這類真實情境，一次練一句完整的話和道地的回應，聽系統語音、在主畫面小工具上複習。
loc.h1: 日常會話：用完整句子按情境練，才開得了口
loc.lead: 單字背了一堆，真的要開口時卻不知道整句怎麼說，對方回一句也接不下去。
loc.answer: 練日常會話，與其再背單字，不如按真實情境學完整的句子，並同時學對方常見的回應；每天練一句、聽完整句的發音，在主畫面小工具上反覆看，開口時才接得上。
paras: 搜尋日常會話的人，多半已經背過不少單字，卻在點餐、問路、結帳這種時候說不出整句。會話靠的是能直接說出口的完整表達，加上聽得懂對方接下來會回什麼；把語言拆成孤立單字，臨場很難組回去。
DailyMate 收錄 47 種學習語言、8,400 句實用生活短句，整理成 14 大主題與 84 個真實情境，從打招呼、點餐、購物、交通、旅遊到職場、看診與緊急狀況。每一句都是完整的句子，並附上道地的回應；每個主題分初級、中級、高級，各 200 句。
用符合所選語言的系統語音聆聽完整句子，把想再用的句子加入收藏，每種學習語言的進度分開記錄。互動式小工具可以在主畫面直接查看句子、切換下一句或加入收藏；Apple Watch 也能查看句子、聆聽系統語音。DailyMate 是付費 App，一次付費即可使用 iPhone、iPad、小工具與 Apple Watch 的完整體驗。

有沒有在主畫面或手錶上隨手複習的方式

從初級開始，一次學一句完整的話和它的回應。
用系統語音把整句聽完，再跟著說一遍。
把想再用的句子加入收藏。
在主畫面小工具切換下一句，通勤時複習。

en.title: Everyday conversation: know the words but freeze, practise full sentences by situation
en.meta: When everyday conversation stalls, the gap is rarely vocabulary; it is never having practised whole sentences and the replies that follow. Learn one complete line and its natural reply per real situation, listen with system voices, and review on a Home Screen widget.
en.h1: Everyday conversation: practise full sentences by situation
en.lead: You have learned plenty of words, yet when it is time to speak you cannot build the sentence, and the reply leaves you stuck.
en.answer: To practise everyday conversation, learn complete sentences grouped by real situations instead of more vocabulary, together with the replies people usually give; take one line a day, listen to the whole sentence, and keep it on a Home Screen widget so it is there when you need it.
paras: Most people searching for everyday conversation already know a fair number of words but cannot say a whole sentence when ordering food, asking the way or paying. Conversation runs on complete expressions you can say straight away, plus knowing what the other person will say next; words learned in isolation are hard to reassemble on the spot.

DailyMate covers 47 learning languages and 8,400 practical everyday phrases in 14 themes and 84 real situations, from greetings, ordering food, shopping and getting around to travel, work, seeing a doctor and emergencies. Every line is a complete sentence with a natural reply, and each theme has 200 beginner, 200 intermediate and 200 advanced lines.

Listen to whole sentences with the system voice that matches the language, save the lines you want to use again, and track progress separately for each learning language. The interactive widget shows a sentence on the Home Screen, moves to the next one or saves it; Apple Watch shows sentences and plays the system voice too. DailyMate is a paid app: one purchase gives the full experience on iPhone, iPad, widgets and Apple Watch.

Whether each line comes with the other person's reply
Whether content is grouped by real situations such as ordering, transport or a doctor's visit
Whether you can listen to the whole sentence
Whether you can review from the Home Screen or a watch
steps: Pick the situation you meet most often, such as ordering food or getting around.
Start at beginner level and learn one complete line with its reply.
Listen to the whole sentence with the system voice, then say it yourself.
Save the lines you want to use again.
Move to the next line on the Home Screen widget during your commute.

One purchase gives the complete app.

Practise complete sentences by situation and learn the usual replies; every DailyMate line is a complete expression with a natural reply.
Which languages can I learn?
DailyMate covers 47 learning languages, with progress and saved lines kept separately for each one.

loc.title: 아이폰 배터리 수명, 충전 습관 중 진짜 중요한 세 가지
loc.meta: 아이폰 배터리 수명은 충전 구간, 열, 충전 속도에서 갈립니다. 습관 하나씩 바꾸고 사이클 수와 성능 최대치 추세로 효과를 확인하는 방법을 정리합니다. BattAI는 충전 관리·충전 구간·충전 속도와 배터리 상태 점수를 기기 안에서 보여 줍니다.
loc.h1: 아이폰 배터리 수명: 충전 습관에서 바꿀 것 세 가지
loc.lead: 배터리 수명을 늘리는 팁은 많지만 대부분은 효과를 확인할 방법이 없습니다. 세 가지만 바꾸고, 바뀌었는지는 숫자로 봅니다.
loc.answer: 아이폰 배터리 수명은 충전 구간(완전 방전과 100% 유지 줄이기), 충전 중 열, 필요 이상 빠른 충전 세 가지에서 가장 크게 갈리며, 습관을 바꾼 뒤 BattAI 같은 앱으로 성능 최대치 추세와 배터리 상태 점수를 같이 보면 효과가 있었는지 확인할 수 있습니다.
paras: 리튬이온 배터리는 쓰는 만큼 조금씩 닳습니다. 닳는 속도를 크게 바꾸는 것은 세 가지입니다. 첫째는 충전 구간입니다. 0% 가까이 자주 떨어뜨리거나 100%에서 오래 머무르면 같은 사용량이라도 더 빨리 닳습니다. 아이폰에는 기종과 iOS 버전에 따라 '최적화된 배터리 충전'이나 충전 한도 설정이 있으니 먼저 켜져 있는지 확인하세요.
둘째는 열입니다. 햇빛 아래 거치대, 뜨거운 차 안, 게임이나 내비게이션을 켠 채 충전하는 습관은 사이클 수와 별개로 배터리를 깎습니다. 셋째는 충전 속도입니다. 급할 때 고속 충전을 쓰는 것은 괜찮지만, 밤새 충전처럼 시간이 넉넉할 때는 굳이 빠를 필요가 없습니다. 열과 속도는 같이 움직이니 둘을 함께 봐야 합니다.

팁을 따라 했는지보다 중요한 것은 결과가 숫자로 보이는지입니다. BattAI는 공개 iOS API의 다섯 가지 값(배터리 잔량, 충전 상태, 저전력 모드, 기기 전체 열 상태, 시간)만 쓰고 나머지는 기록에서 계산하며, 각 항목에 출처와 한계를 표시합니다. 충전 관리, 충전 구간, 충전 속도와 함께 배터리 상태 점수, 점수를 만드는 요소, 성능 최대치 추세를 보여 주고, 광고·분석·추적·네트워크 요청이 없습니다.
look: 평소 몇 %에서 충전을 시작하고 몇 %까지 채우는지
충전하는 동안 기기가 뜨거워지는 상황이 언제인지
시간이 넉넉한 밤에도 고속 충전을 쓰고 있는지
'최적화된 배터리 충전'이나 충전 한도 설정이 켜져 있는지
앱이 값을 어디서 읽는지 출처와 한계를 표시하는지
steps: 설정 > 배터리에서 충전 관련 옵션(최적화된 배터리 충전, 충전 한도)이 켜져 있는지 확인합니다.
일주일 동안 충전을 시작하는 %와 끝내는 %를 그대로 기록해 지금의 충전 구간을 봅니다.
0% 근처까지 쓰는 일을 줄이고, 중간중간 짧게 충전하는 쪽으로 바꿉니다.
뜨거운 곳에서는 충전을 멈추고, 충전하면서 게임이나 내비게이션을 오래 쓰지 않습니다.
한 달 뒤 사이클 수와 성능 최대치 추세를 다시 보고, 바꾸기 전 한 달과 비교합니다.
rows: 완전 방전과 100% 유지가 잦으면 더 빨리 닳습니다
열과 함께 움직여서 둘을 같이 봐야 합니다

faq: 밤새 충전하면 배터리 수명이 줄어듭니까?

en.title: iPhone battery lifespan: the three charging habits that matter
en.meta: iPhone battery lifespan comes down to charge range, heat and charge rate. Change one habit at a time and check the effect with cycle count and maximum capacity over time. BattAI shows charge care, charge range, charge rate and a battery health score on the device.
en.h1: iPhone battery lifespan: three charging habits to change
en.lead: There are plenty of battery lifespan tips, and most give you no way to tell whether they worked. Change three things and check the result in numbers.
en.answer: iPhone battery lifespan depends most on charge range (less time at empty or sitting at 100 percent), heat while charging and charging faster than you need; after changing those habits, an app such as BattAI lets you read maximum capacity over time and a battery health score together to see whether it helped.
paras: A lithium-ion battery wears a little with use. Three things change how fast. The first is charge range: dropping close to 0 percent often or sitting at 100 percent for long periods wears it faster for the same use. Depending on the model and iOS version, iPhone has Optimized Battery Charging or a charge limit setting, so check that first.

The second is heat. A mount in direct sun, a hot car, or charging while gaming or navigating wears the battery independently of cycle count. The third is charge rate. Fast charging when you are in a hurry is fine, but overnight there is no reason to rush. Heat and rate move together, so read them together.

What matters more than following tips is whether the result shows up in numbers. BattAI uses five values from public iOS APIs, battery level, charge state, Low Power Mode, whole-device thermal state and time, calculates the rest from those readings, and shows the source and limits of each detail. It shows charge care, charge range and charge rate alongside a battery health score, what shapes the score, and maximum capacity over time, with no ads, analytics, tracking or internet requests.

For one week, note the percentage where each charge starts and ends to see your current charge range.
Run down close to 0 percent less often and top up in shorter sessions instead.
Stop charging somewhere hot, and avoid long gaming or navigation sessions while charging.
After a month, look at cycle count and maximum capacity over time again and compare with the month before.

en.fits: BattAI is for people who want to see in numbers whether battery lifespan tips actually worked: charge care, charge range, charge rate, a battery health score and what shapes it, and maximum capacity over time, all on the device, with no ads, analytics, tracking or internet requests. One payment, no subscription.
faq: Does charging overnight shorten battery lifespan?
The issue is long stretches at 100 percent. Depending on the model and iOS version, Optimized Battery Charging or a charge limit cuts that time.
Should I avoid fast charging?
Use it when you are in a hurry. Fast charging tends to make more heat, so skip it when there is time or the phone is already hot.
Where does BattAI send my data?

Not to any server. There are no ads, analytics, tracking or internet requests; data stays on the device except a minimal snapshot sent directly to your paired Apple Watch, and battery reports are created on the device and never uploaded.

loc.h1: 排卵期徵兆：哪些變化值得記、怎麼記才看得出規律
loc.lead: 排卵期不一定是週期第 14 天，也不是每個人都有感覺。把身體訊號連同日期記下來，幾個週期後才看得出自己的排卵期大概落在哪裡。
loc.answer: 排卵期常見的訊號是分泌物變多、變得透明有彈性，有些人會單側下腹悶痛或胸部脹痛，但訊號因人而異；把這些變化和日期一起記三到四個週期，再用 Cyca 這類依自己紀錄推估易孕期與排卵日的 App 對照，比套用固定的第 14 天更貼近自己。
paras: 排卵通常發生在下次月經來之前大約 14 天，所以週期 28 天的人大約落在第 14 天，週期 32 天的人就晚好幾天。易孕期一般抓排卵日前幾天到排卵當天，因為精子可以存活數天、卵子只有約一天。這也是為什麼週期長短不固定的人，用固定天數推算常常抓不準。
身體在排卵前後常有幾個變化：分泌物變多、變得透明有彈性；有些人會有一側下腹悶悶的痛，持續幾小時到一兩天；也有人胸部脹、情緒或食慾不同。不是每個人每次都有，單看一次也不準，連續幾個週期記下來對照日期，才看得出自己的模式。

en.title: Ovulation signs: what to notice and log each cycle
en.meta: Common ovulation signs include more, clearer and stretchier discharge, one-sided lower belly ache and breast tenderness, but they differ from person to person. Log the signs with dates for a few cycles to find your own window. Cyca estimates fertile days and ovulation from your own records, kept on the device.
en.h1: Ovulation signs: which changes are worth logging and how to spot your pattern
en.lead: Ovulation is not always on day 14, and not everyone feels it. Log body signs with dates and after a few cycles you can see roughly where your own ovulation falls.
en.answer: Common ovulation signs are more discharge that turns clear and stretchy, and for some people a one-sided lower belly ache or breast tenderness, but signs vary; log them with dates for three or four cycles and compare with an app such as Cyca that estimates fertile days and ovulation from your own records, which fits you better than assuming day 14.
paras: Ovulation usually happens about 14 days before the next period, so someone with a 28-day cycle ovulates around day 14 and someone with a 32-day cycle several days later. The fertile window is usually counted as the few days before ovulation through ovulation day, because sperm can survive several days and an egg about one day. That is why a fixed day count often misses for people whose cycle length varies.

The body often changes around ovulation: more discharge that becomes clear and stretchy; for some, a dull ache on one side of the lower belly lasting a few hours to a day or two; for others, tender breasts or shifts in mood or appetite. Not everyone has them every time, and one cycle tells you little. Logging several cycles against dates shows your own pattern.

What matters in the log is dates and how you feel. Cyca lets you note flow, symptoms, moods and notes in seconds and shows your next period, fertile days and ovulation day on a calm calendar, adjusting after every entry; all data stays on your iPhone, with no account and no cloud. Cyca provides estimates, is not a medical device and must not be used as contraception; if you have been trying to conceive for a while without success or your cycle changes noticeably, see a gynecologist.

faq: Is ovulation always on day 14 after a period starts?
No. Ovulation is about 14 days before the next period, so it moves later or earlier when the cycle is longer or shorter than 28 days.
If I feel nothing, does that mean I am not ovulating?
Not necessarily. Many people feel nothing obvious; if your cycle is irregular for a long time or you are worried, see a gynecologist.
