loc.title: 스마트폰 중독일까? 사용 습관 자가 점검과 시간대별로 줄이는 법
loc.meta: 폰을 내려놓기 어렵다면 먼저 언제, 어떤 앱에서 시간이 새는지 점검하세요. 잠들기 전·공부·아침처럼 시간대를 정해 방해 앱을 잠그고 사용 시간을 줄이는 방법을 정리했습니다.
loc.h1: 스마트폰 중독이 걱정될 때: 점검하고, 시간대별로 줄이기
loc.lead: "5분만" 하고 열었는데 한 시간이 지나 있다면, 의지가 약해서가 아니라 폰을 여는 순간이 습관처럼 굳어 있기 때문인 경우가 많습니다. 사용 시간을 줄이려면 막연히 참기보다, 시간이 새는 시간대를 찾아 그때만 확실히 막는 편이 현실적입니다.
loc.answer: 스마트폰 사용이 지나치다고 느껴지면, 먼저 하루 중 가장 오래 쓰는 시간대와 앱을 적어 보세요. 그다음 그 시간대 하나(예: 잠들기 전 30분)만 정해 방해 앱을 타이머로 잠그고, 끝나면 자동으로 풀리게 합니다. 한 시간대가 익숙해지면 공부·아침 시간으로 넓혀 가는 방식이 오래갑니다. 일상생활이 크게 어려울 정도라면 전문가 상담도 함께 고려하세요.
paras: '중독'이라는 말이 무겁게 느껴지지만, 많은 사람이 겪는 문제는 대부분 특정 순간에 반복되는 습관입니다. 침대에 누웠을 때, 공부를 시작하기 직전, 아침에 눈뜨자마자처럼 폰을 여는 계기가 정해져 있습니다. 하루 전체를 줄이려 하면 금방 지치지만, 계기가 되는 시간대 하나를 막으면 체감되는 변화가 큽니다.

시간대를 정했다면 그 시간에는 선택이 필요 없게 만드는 것이 핵심입니다. LockHour Pro는 모드를 고르고 한 번 탭하면 선택한 앱과 웹사이트를 타이머가 끝날 때까지 잠그고, 시간이 되면 자동으로 풀어 줍니다. 잠들기 전 모드는 밤에 폰을 내려놓도록, 아침 리셋은 스크롤보다 하루를 먼저 시작하도록, 공부 모드는 뽀모도로식 집중과 휴식을 반복하도록 돕습니다.
중간에 풀고 싶은 충동이 문제라면 하드 모드를 켜 보세요. 멈추려면 60초를 기다린 뒤 확인 문구를 직접 입력해야 해서, 충동이 아니라 결정으로 멈추게 됩니다. 오늘 집중한 시간, 주간 차트, 연속 기록, 되찾은 총 시간을 보면 줄인 시간이 눈에 보여 다음 날도 이어 가기 쉽습니다.

en.title: Smartphone addiction? Check your habits and cut back by time of day
en.meta: If putting your phone down is hard, first check when and in which apps your time leaks. How to pick time slots such as bedtime, study or morning, lock distracting apps then, and reduce your screen time.
en.h1: Worried about smartphone addiction: check, then cut back by time of day
en.lead: If "just five minutes" keeps turning into an hour, it is often not weak willpower but a habit fixed to certain moments. To reduce screen time, finding the time slot where it leaks and blocking only that slot works better than simply trying to resist.
en.answer: If your phone use feels excessive, first write down the time of day and the apps where you spend the most time. Then pick one slot (for example the 30 minutes before sleep), lock distracting apps with a timer and let them unlock automatically when it ends. Once that slot feels normal, extend to study or morning time. If daily life is seriously affected, consider talking to a professional as well.
paras: The word "addiction" sounds heavy, but what most people struggle with is a habit repeated at specific moments: lying in bed, right before studying, the moment they wake up. Trying to cut the whole day at once is exhausting, while blocking one trigger slot brings a change you can feel.

Once the slot is chosen, the key is to remove the choice during it. In LockHour Pro you pick a mode and tap once, and the apps and websites you selected stay locked until the timer ends, then unlock automatically. Before Sleep helps you put the phone down at night, Morning Reset starts the day before the scroll, and Study Mode repeats Pomodoro-style focus and breaks.

If the urge to quit midway is the problem, turn on Hard Mode. Stopping early means waiting 60 seconds and typing a confirmation phrase, so you stop by decision rather than impulse. Today's focus time, a weekly chart, streaks and total time reclaimed make the reduction visible, which makes the next day easier.

en.fits: LockHour Pro suits people who want to reduce and manage their phone time themselves, especially when the leaks happen at fixed moments such as bedtime or study time. It is not a treatment or diagnostic tool; it locks distracting apps for the time you set and unlocks them automatically when it ends. Widgets, the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island show the time left. One purchase unlocks everything, with no subscription and no ads.
faq: Can an app tell me whether I am addicted to my smartphone?
This app is not a diagnostic tool. It records focus time and time reclaimed, which helps you look back on your habits. If daily life is seriously affected, talk to a professional.
Isn't deleting the apps better?
Deleting apps you need often ends with reinstalling them. Locking them only in chosen slots lets you use them when needed and cut just the leaking time.
I keep unlocking midway.
With Hard Mode on, you wait 60 seconds and type a confirmation phrase before stopping. That gap gives you a moment to decide whether you really want to stop.

loc.title: 幼兒幾歲可以學注音？先聽音、再描寫的起步法，與一次買斷 App 怎麼選
loc.meta: 幼兒學注音不必急著寫字。從聽音配對開始，再到筆順描寫、拼讀與聲調，每次幾分鐘就好。也整理給幼兒用的注音 App 該注意的無廣告、無內購與離線條件。
loc.h1: 幼兒注音：先玩聽音，再慢慢拼讀與描寫
loc.lead: 孩子三、四歲就對注音有興趣，爸媽常擔心太早學會不會有壓力。其實幼兒階段的重點不是寫對，而是先聽得出、認得出；只要順序對、時間短，學注音可以像玩遊戲一樣自然。
loc.answer: 幼兒學注音，建議從「聽音認符號」開始，而不是從寫字開始：先讓孩子聽到發音、找到對的注音，熟了再跟著筆順描寫，之後才用拼讀把聲母、介音、韻母拼成一個音，聲調放最後。每次幾分鐘、每天一點，比一次練很久更適合幼兒。
paras: 幼兒的手部肌肉還在發展，一開始就要求寫得工整，容易讓孩子對注音產生排斥。先從耳朵和眼睛下手：聽到「ㄇ」能指出ㄇ，看到ㄚ能說出音。在 Lumi注音星球 Pro 裡，配對餵食讓孩子餵小夥伴吃對的注音，注音釣魚則是聽到發音後釣出正確的魚，都是用聽和認來記符號。
認得的注音多了，再加上描寫。魔法描寫讓孩子用手指跟著筆順描，先熟悉字形和筆順就好，不必要求一次寫漂亮。家長專區可以把學過或最近答錯的注音一鍵印成描寫與測驗學習單，想讓孩子拿筆練的時候，就在紙上再練一次。
拼讀和聲調是下一步。拼音小火車把聲母、介音、韻母拼成一個音，聲調雲霄飛車再練一聲到輕聲的分辨。「今日複習」會自動挑出還不熟的注音，幼兒忘得快，這種小份量的重複正好合適。給幼兒用的 App 也要看干擾：Pro 版一次購買全部內容，沒有廣告、沒有內購彈窗、不需登入和網路。

en.title: What age can toddlers start zhuyin? Listen first, trace later, and choosing a pay-once app
en.meta: Young children do not need to start zhuyin by writing. Begin with listening and matching, then stroke-order tracing, blending and tones, a few minutes at a time, plus what to check in a zhuyin app for little kids: no ads, no in-app purchases, offline.
en.h1: Zhuyin for young children: play with sounds first, then blend and trace
en.lead: When a three- or four-year-old shows interest in zhuyin, parents often worry that starting early adds pressure. At this age the goal is not writing correctly but hearing and recognising the symbols; with the right order and short sessions, learning zhuyin can feel like play.
en.answer: For young children, start zhuyin with listening and recognising symbols rather than writing: let your child hear a sound and find the right symbol, then trace it in stroke order once it is familiar, and only after that blend initial, medial and final into one syllable, leaving tones for last. A few minutes every day suits little children better than one long session.
paras: Young children's hand muscles are still developing, and demanding neat writing from the start can make them resist zhuyin. Begin with ears and eyes: hearing "m" and pointing to ㄇ, seeing ㄚ and saying the sound. In Lumi Bopomofo Pro, the feeding match game has your child feed a cute buddy the right symbol, and zhuyin fishing asks them to catch the right fish after hearing a sound, so symbols are remembered through listening and recognising.

Once more symbols are familiar, add tracing. Magic tracing lets your child follow the stroke order with a finger; getting used to the shape and order is enough, without expecting neat results right away. In the parent area you can print learned or recently missed symbols as tracing and quiz worksheets in one tap, for when your child wants to practise with a pencil.

Blending and tones come next. The sound train joins initial, medial and final into one syllable, and the tone roller coaster practises telling the four tones and the neutral tone apart. Today's Review automatically picks symbols that are still shaky; young children forget quickly, so small repeated doses fit well. Distractions matter in an app for little kids: the Pro version unlocks everything with one purchase, with no ads, no in-app purchase pop-ups, and no sign-in or internet needed.

loc.title: 子どものアルファベットの書き方：大文字と小文字どちらから？書き順と練習の進め方
loc.meta: アルファベットを書く練習は、なぞる前に文字の名前と音を聞くと定着しやすくなります。大文字と小文字の順番、書き順の考え方、画面と紙の練習の組み合わせ方をまとめました。
loc.h1: 子どものアルファベットの書き方：聞いて、なぞって、紙で書く
loc.lead: 「アルファベットを書かせたいけれど、大文字からか小文字からか、書き順もよく分からない」という保護者は少なくありません。書き方の練習は、いきなりノートに書くより、文字を聞いて知り、ガイドに沿ってなぞる段階を挟むとスムーズです。
loc.answer: 子どもにアルファベットの書き方を教えるときは、まず文字の名前と音を聞かせ、次に大文字、慣れたら同じ文字の小文字を、書き始めの位置と書き順に沿ってなぞらせます。画面で指なぞりに慣れたら、練習した文字を紙に印刷して鉛筆でもう一度書くと、形が定着しやすくなります。1回数分、1日数文字で十分です。
paras: 大文字は直線が多く形が安定しているので、最初の数文字は大文字から入る家庭が多いです。小文字は b と d、p と q のように向きがまぎらわしい文字があるので、同じ文字の大文字に慣れてから、ペアで練習すると混乱しにくくなります。Lumi レター Lite では、文字の名前と音を聞いてから、大文字と小文字を書き順ガイドに沿ってなぞります。
書き方で大事なのは、どこから書き始めて、どちらへ線を引くかです。十字のガイド線があると、小さな子どもでも文字の高さや中心をつかみやすくなります。きれいに書けなくても、書き始めの位置と線の順番が合っていれば十分。形はくり返すうちに整っていきます。

en.title: How kids learn to write the alphabet: capitals or lowercase first, and stroke order
en.meta: Alphabet writing sticks better when children hear each letter's name and sound before tracing. Which comes first, capitals or lowercase, how to think about stroke order, and how to combine screen and paper practice.
en.h1: How kids learn to write the alphabet: hear it, trace it, write it on paper
en.lead: Many parents want their child to start writing the alphabet but are unsure whether to begin with capitals or lowercase, or what the stroke order is. Writing goes more smoothly when there is a step between knowing the letter by sound and tracing it along a guide, rather than jumping straight into a notebook.
en.answer: When teaching a child to write the alphabet, first let them hear the letter's name and sound, then trace the capital, and once that is familiar the lowercase of the same letter, following the starting point and stroke order. After finger tracing on screen feels easy, print the letters practised and write them again with a pencil so the shapes stick. A few minutes and a few letters a day are enough.
paras: Capitals have more straight lines and stable shapes, so many families start the first few letters with capitals. Lowercase has confusable pairs such as b and d or p and q, so practising each lowercase letter after its capital, as a pair, reduces mix-ups. In Lumi Letters Lite, children hear the letter's name and sound, then trace capitals and lowercase along a stroke-order guide.

What matters in writing is where to start and which way to draw. A cross-shaped guide line helps small children find the height and centre of a letter. Neatness is not the goal yet; if the starting point and stroke order are right, the shape improves with repetition.

Once screen tracing is comfortable, move to paper. Lumi Letters can export a PDF worksheet in one tap with the letters practised that day and tracing boxes, so you can print it and continue with a pencil. Without a purchase, all the games for the letter A and the first star adventure are playable; one purchase opens all 26 letters in capitals and lowercase.

faq: Should kids write capitals or lowercase first?
Capitals, with their stable shapes, are an easy start for the first few letters. Once familiar, practise the lowercase of the same letter as a pair.
Does stroke order matter?
When the starting point and order are right, direction mix-ups such as b and d are easier to avoid. Neatness comes later.
At what age can writing practice start?
It depends on the child. If a pencil is still hard, start with finger tracing and move to paper once it feels easy.

loc.title: 自然發音是什麼？和背 ABC 差在哪，在家照四個步驟練，一次買斷 App 怎麼選
loc.meta: 自然發音（Phonics）是學字母代表的「音」，不是只背字母名。整理在家從字母音、開頭音、結尾音到中間音的練習順序，以及挑選無訂閱、無廣告自然發音 App 的重點。
loc.h1: 自然發音：從「背字母名」走到「聽得出字母音」
loc.lead: 孩子 ABC 唱得很熟，看到 cat 卻念不出來，這是很多家長開始找自然發音的原因。字母名是「A 叫 ei」，自然發音學的是「a 在 cat 裡發什麼音」；兩件事不一樣，順序也有講究。
loc.answer: 自然發音（Phonics）是讓孩子把字母和它代表的音連起來，進而聽音拼讀單字。在家可以照四步走：先分清每個字母的「字母名」與「字母音」，再練聽出單字的開頭音，接著是結尾音，最後才是最難的中間音，熟了之後看圖拼讀。每天一小段，比一次練很久有效。
paras: 背 ABC 只學到字母的名字，但讀單字需要的是字母的音。所以自然發音的第一步，是讓孩子同時聽到「字母名」和「字母音」，知道 b 叫 bee、發 /b/。Lumi 字母星球 Pro 會先讓孩子聽字母名與字母音，再進到開頭音、結尾音、中間音，最後看圖拼讀，這也是英語系幼兒園常見的自然發音教學順序。
為什麼中間音放最後？因為開頭和結尾的音最容易聽出來，夾在中間的母音最難。孩子能從 cat、cup、car 聽出相同的開頭 /k/，再從 cat、hat 聽出相同結尾，最後才分辨 cat 和 cut 中間不同的音。App 裡 14 顆星球、12 種題型循序漸進，包括聽音選字母、看圖找開頭與結尾音、大小寫配對、補字母等。
聽音之外，也要讓「音」和「形」連起來。字母挑戰是聽聲音選字母，ABC 字母樂園則跟著真實筆順與十字格輔助線描寫大小寫。家長專區把表現分成字母認讀、字母順序、語音覺識、看圖拼讀四項能力，也能一鍵匯出 PDF 今日學習單在紙上再練。Pro 版一次買斷，沒有訂閱、沒有自動續扣、完全無廣告。

中間的母音本來就最難聽出。先把開頭音和結尾音練熟，中間音會比較容易。

en.title: What is phonics? How it differs from memorising ABC, a four-step home order, and choosing a pay-once app
en.meta: Phonics is learning the sounds letters stand for, not just their names. A home practice order from letter sounds to first, last and middle sounds, plus what to look for in a phonics app with no subscription and no ads.
en.h1: Phonics: from memorising letter names to hearing letter sounds
en.lead: A child can sing the ABC song perfectly yet cannot read cat, which is why many parents start looking into phonics. A letter's name is "A is ay"; phonics is "what sound a makes in cat". They are different things, and the order matters.
en.answer: Phonics helps children connect letters with the sounds they stand for so they can hear and blend words. At home, go in four steps: first tell each letter's name from its sound, then practise hearing the first sound of a word, then the last sound, and finally the hardest one, the middle sound, followed by reading words from pictures. A short session every day works better than one long one.
paras: Memorising ABC teaches only letter names, but reading words needs letter sounds. So the first step of phonics is hearing both the letter name and the letter sound, knowing that b is called bee and says /b/. Lumi Letters Pro starts with letter names and sounds, then moves to first, last and middle sounds and finally reading from pictures, the order commonly used in English-speaking preschools.

Why do middle sounds come last? First and last sounds are easiest to hear; the vowel in the middle is hardest. A child can hear the shared first sound /k/ in cat, cup and car, then the shared ending in cat and hat, and only later tell the different middle sounds of cat and cut. The app's 14 planets and 12 question types build up step by step, including listening and choosing letters, finding first and last sounds from pictures, matching capitals and lowercase, and filling missing letters.

Beyond listening, sound and shape need to connect. The letter challenge asks children to pick a letter after hearing a sound, and the ABC letter park traces capitals and lowercase with real stroke order and cross guide lines. The parent area splits progress into four skills, letter recognition, letter order, phonemic awareness and picture reading, and can export a daily PDF worksheet for paper practice. The Pro version is a one-time purchase with no subscription, no auto-renewal and no ads.

faq: How is phonics different from phonetic symbols such as KK?
Phonics reads sounds straight from letters to blend words; phonetic symbols are a separate notation. Young children usually start with phonics.
At what age can phonics start?
It depends on the child. Once they can sing ABC and recognise some letters, you can start slowly with letter sounds and first sounds.
Why can't my child hear the middle sound?
The vowel in the middle is naturally the hardest to hear. Get first and last sounds solid first, and middle sounds become easier.

loc.title: Toán lớp 1: bé đã sẵn sàng chưa? Bài kiểm tra 5 phút tại nhà trước ngày khai giảng
loc.meta: Toán lớp 1 cả năm học những gì, và bé cần vững nền tảng nào trước khi vào lớp. Sáu câu hỏi bố mẹ tự kiểm tra trong 5 phút, kèm cách bù phần bé còn hổng.
loc.h1: Toán lớp 1: kiểm tra nhanh xem bé đã sẵn sàng chưa
loc.lead: Nhiều bố mẹ lo bé vào lớp 1 sẽ theo không kịp môn toán, rồi cho bé làm thật nhiều phiếu bài tập. Thật ra điều quan trọng hơn là biết bé đang hổng ở đâu. Một bài kiểm tra ngắn tại nhà cho bạn câu trả lời rõ ràng hơn mười trang bài tập.
loc.answer: Toán lớp 1 xoay quanh số đến 100, cộng và trừ, so sánh số, nhận biết hình và xem giờ. Trước khi vào lớp, bé chỉ cần vững ba nền tảng: đếm đúng số lượng đồ vật, biết số nào lớn hơn, và hiểu một số có thể tách thành hai phần (5 gồm 2 và 3). Nếu bé làm được ba việc này, phần còn lại sẽ học trên lớp.
paras: Lớp 1 không đòi hỏi bé tính nhanh. Điều cô giáo cần là bé hiểu con số đại diện cho bao nhiêu đồ vật. Một bé đọc thuộc 1 đến 100 nhưng đếm năm cái kẹo lại ra sáu thì vẫn chưa sẵn sàng; ngược lại, một bé đếm chậm nhưng chính xác sẽ theo kịp rất nhanh.

Nền tảng thứ hai là so sánh: nhìn hai nhóm đồ vật và nói được nhóm nào nhiều hơn, rồi chuyển sang so sánh hai con số. Nền tảng thứ ba là tách – gộp: biết 5 có thể là 1 và 4, 2 và 3. Đây chính là cơ sở của phép cộng, trừ ở lớp 1, nên bé hiểu được phần này thì không cần học thuộc lòng bảng cộng.

Kiểm tra bằng đồ vật thật trong nhà, không cần giấy bút: thìa, hạt, đồ chơi. Mỗi câu chỉ hỏi một lần, không gợi ý, ghi lại câu nào bé lúng túng. Phần lúng túng đó là nơi bạn luyện trong vài tuần còn lại trước khai giảng.

Lumi Math Planet dùng câu hỏi bằng hình và đọc to từng câu, nên bé chưa biết đọc vẫn tự làm được. Bố mẹ xem tiến bộ ở năm nhóm kỹ năng để thấy ngay phần nào còn yếu, cho bé luyện riêng phần đó, và in phiếu bài tập kèm đáp án để bé làm trên giấy. Bé bắt đầu mà không cần mua với hành tinh đầu tiên và thử thách hằng ngày; một lần mua trong ứng dụng duy nhất mở khóa toàn bộ, không thuê bao.

en.title: Grade 1 math: is your child ready? A five-minute home check before school starts
en.meta: What grade 1 math covers over the year, and which foundations your child needs before starting. Six questions parents can check at home in five minutes, plus how to fill the gaps.
en.h1: Grade 1 math: a quick check of whether your child is ready
en.lead: Many parents worry their child will fall behind in grade 1 math and hand over stacks of worksheets. What matters more is knowing where the gaps are. A short check at home gives a clearer answer than ten pages of exercises.
en.answer: Grade 1 math centres on numbers to 100, addition and subtraction, comparing numbers, recognising shapes and telling the time. Before starting, a child only needs three solid foundations: counting objects correctly, knowing which number is bigger, and understanding that a number splits into two parts (5 is 2 and 3). If your child can do these three things, the rest is learned in class.
paras: Grade 1 does not require fast calculation. What the teacher needs is a child who understands how many objects a number stands for. A child who recites 1 to 100 but counts five sweets as six is not ready yet; a child who counts slowly but accurately catches up quickly.

The second foundation is comparing: looking at two groups and saying which has more, then moving on to comparing two numbers. The third is splitting and combining: knowing that 5 can be 1 and 4, or 2 and 3. This is the basis of grade 1 addition and subtraction, so a child who understands it does not need to memorise addition tables.

Check with real objects at home, no pen or paper needed: spoons, beans, toys. Ask each question once, without hints, and note where your child hesitates. Those hesitations are what to practise in the weeks before school starts.

Lumi Math Planet uses picture questions and reads every question aloud, so children who cannot read yet can work on their own. Parents see progress across five skill groups to spot weak areas at once, let the child practise just those, and print worksheets with answers for paper practice.

loc.h1: 一年級數學練習：一週練習表與每天 15 分鐘的排法
loc.lead: 孩子上一年級後，很多家長的做法是買一本評量、每天寫兩頁。寫了一個月，孩子越寫越慢、錯的總是同一種題，家長也不知道該從哪裡補。練習不在多，而在每天練對的那一塊。
loc.answer: 一年級數學每天練 15 分鐘就夠，重點是輪流練四種東西：計算（加減與位值）、思考題（找規律、比大小、應用題）、孩子最常錯的題型，以及每週一次離開螢幕的紙筆練習。每天只練一種，週末看一次哪一類分數最低，下週多排一天給它。
paras: 一年級常見的單元包括 100 以內的數與位值、加減法（含進位與退位）、比長短、認識形狀，以及看時鐘。家長最容易只盯計算，但卡住孩子的常常是應用題：題目一長、字一多，孩子就不知道要加還是要減。所以練習表裡一定要有思考題的日子。
每天 15 分鐘比週末一次寫一小時有效。一年級孩子專注的時間短，寫太久反而把錯誤練熟。固定時段（例如晚餐後）、固定長度，孩子比較不會討價還價。
補弱項時，不是把錯的那一題重寫一次，而是同一種題型換新數字再練幾題。例如孩子退位減法常錯，就連續幾天各練幾題不同數字的退位減法，直到正確率穩定。

en.title: How to plan grade 1 math practice: a five-day, 15-minutes-a-day home schedule (with printable worksheets)
en.meta: What should grade 1 children practise in math at home, and for how long? A weekly plan rotating calculation, thinking problems, weak spots and paper practice, plus what to check in a one-time-purchase, ad-free practice app.
en.h1: Grade 1 math practice: a weekly plan and how to use 15 minutes a day
en.lead: Once children start grade 1, many parents buy a workbook and set two pages a day. A month later the child is slower, keeps getting the same kind of question wrong, and parents do not know where to start. Practice is not about volume; it is about practising the right part each day.
en.answer: Fifteen minutes a day is enough for grade 1 math, as long as you rotate four things: calculation (addition, subtraction and place value), thinking problems (patterns, comparing, word problems), the question types your child gets wrong most, and a weekly paper session away from the screen. Practise one kind per day, check at the weekend which area scores lowest, and give it an extra day next week.
paras: Common grade 1 topics include numbers to 100 and place value, addition and subtraction (including carrying and borrowing), comparing lengths, recognising shapes and reading clocks. Parents tend to watch only calculation, but what often stops children is word problems: once a question gets long and wordy, the child does not know whether to add or subtract. So the plan needs thinking-problem days.

Fifteen minutes a day works better than an hour at the weekend. Grade 1 children have short attention spans, and long sessions only make mistakes stick. A fixed time (after dinner, say) and a fixed length mean less bargaining.

Fixing a weak spot does not mean redoing the wrong question; it means practising the same question type with new numbers. If subtraction with borrowing keeps going wrong, practise a few borrowing questions with different numbers on several days until accuracy is steady.

loc.h1: Abendroutine für Kinder: Reihenfolge, Dauer und was beim Trödeln hilft
loc.lead: Nach einem langen Kita-Tag sind Kinder müde, und genau dann sollen Abendessen, Aufräumen, Zähneputzen und Schlafanzug klappen. Viele Eltern erklären jeden Abend neu, was als Nächstes kommt. Eine feste Abendroutine nimmt diese Verhandlungen aus dem Abend.
loc.answer: Eine Abendroutine für Kinder funktioniert am besten mit vier bis fünf Schritten in immer derselben Reihenfolge, zum Beispiel Abendessen, Aufräumen, Zähneputzen, Schlafanzug, Licht aus. Das Kind sollte jeden Schritt selbst abhaken können und sofort merken, dass er geschafft ist. Fangen Sie früh genug an, damit niemand hetzen muss.
paras: Kinder zwischen drei und sieben Jahren können sich eine lange Liste nicht merken, eine feste Reihenfolge dagegen schon. Wenn jeden Abend dasselbe nach demselben kommt, muss das Kind nicht mehr fragen, was jetzt dran ist, und Sie müssen es nicht mehr ansagen.

Trödeln ist am Abend selten Trotz, sondern meist Müdigkeit. Hilfreich ist, die Schritte klein und sichtbar zu machen: nicht „mach dich bettfertig“, sondern „Zähne putzen“ als eigener Schritt. Jeder abgehakte Schritt ist ein kleiner Erfolg, und das Kind sieht, wie weit es schon ist.

Diskussionen entstehen oft, weil die Routine jeden Abend ein bisschen anders ist. Halten Sie Reihenfolge und Start möglichst konstant, auch am Wochenende. Änderungen besprechen Sie tagsüber, nicht mitten in der Routine.

en.title: An evening routine for kids after daycare: the right order and what helps with dawdling
en.meta: The most common questions about evening routines for children aged three to seven: which order, how long, what helps with dawdling and arguments, and what to look for in an ad-free, one-time-purchase routine app.
en.h1: Evening routine for kids: order, length and what helps with dawdling
en.lead: After a long day at daycare, children are tired, and that is exactly when dinner, tidying, tooth brushing and pyjamas are supposed to happen. Many parents explain what comes next anew every evening. A fixed evening routine takes the negotiating out of the night.
en.answer: An evening routine for kids works best with four to five steps in the same order every night, for example dinner, tidy-up, tooth brushing, pyjamas, lights out. The child should be able to tick off each step and see straight away that it is done. Start early enough that nobody has to rush.
paras: Children aged three to seven cannot remember a long list, but they can remember a fixed order. When the same thing follows the same thing every evening, the child no longer has to ask what is next, and you no longer have to announce it.

Dawdling in the evening is rarely defiance; it is usually tiredness. It helps to make the steps small and visible: not get ready for bed, but brush teeth as a step of its own. Each ticked step is a small success, and the child sees how far they have come.

Arguments often start because the routine is a little different each night. Keep the order and the start time as constant as possible, weekends included. Discuss changes during the day, not in the middle of the routine.

loc.meta: Cả nhà định đi chơi cuối tuần nhưng sợ mưa bất chợt hay nắng gắt? Cách xem dự báo 7 ngày, chọn khung giờ ra ngoài và chuẩn bị đồ cho cả gia đình, theo thứ tự từ giữa tuần đến sáng hôm đi.
loc.h1: Thời tiết gia đình: lên kế hoạch đi chơi cuối tuần theo dự báo
loc.lead: Đi chơi cả nhà khác với một người ra ngoài: có người lớn tuổi, có trẻ nhỏ, có xe chở nhiều đồ, và chỉ cần một cơn mưa chiều là cả chuyến đi đổ bể. Việc xem thời tiết vì thế nên bắt đầu từ giữa tuần, không phải sáng hôm đi.
loc.answer: Hãy xem thời tiết theo ba mốc: giữa tuần xem dự báo 7 ngày để chọn ngày đi, tối hôm trước xem dự báo ngày mai để biết có mưa, lạnh hơn hay nóng hơn không, và sáng hôm đi xem biểu đồ theo giờ để chọn khung giờ ít mưa, UV thấp. Chuẩn bị đồ theo dự báo và chia sẻ danh sách cho cả nhà để không ai quên.
paras: Dự báo càng xa càng ít chắc chắn, nên giữa tuần chỉ dùng để chọn giữa thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật, hoặc quyết định đi chơi trong nhà hay ngoài trời. Đừng chốt giờ giấc lúc này.
Tối hôm trước là lúc chốt kế hoạch. Nếu ngày mai có khả năng mưa vào buổi chiều, dời phần ngoài trời lên buổi sáng; nếu trời nóng hơn, chuẩn bị thêm nước, mũ và kem chống nắng cho cả nhà.

Sáng hôm đi, nhìn biểu đồ nhiệt độ 24 giờ và chi tiết theo từng giờ để chọn khung giờ ra ngoài. Ở nhiều nơi tại Việt Nam, mùa mưa thường có mưa rào vào buổi chiều, nên đi sớm và về trước giờ mưa thường là lựa chọn an toàn.

Lumi Thời tiết gom các yếu tố này thành chỉ số ra ngoài từ 0 đến 100, tính từ nhiệt độ cảm nhận, khả năng mưa, UV, gió và bầu trời; chạm vào điểm số để xem từng yếu tố. Ứng dụng cho biết khung giờ lý tưởng để ra ngoài, gợi ý nên mặc gì, có cần ô hay kem chống nắng không, và có danh sách đồ cần mang có thể chia sẻ cho cả nhà. Bạn còn lưu được những nơi hay đến, như nhà ông bà hay công viên, để xem thời tiết ở đó.

Lưu nhiều địa điểm, có tiện ích Màn hình chính và Apple Watch. Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo; mở khóa một lần trong ứng dụng để dùng toàn bộ tính năng, không có gói đăng ký.
faq: Nên xem thời tiết trước chuyến đi bao lâu?
Xem dự báo 7 ngày từ giữa tuần để chọn ngày, rồi chốt kế hoạch vào tối hôm trước khi dự báo đã chắc hơn.
Mùa mưa có nên đi chơi cuối tuần không?
Vẫn được, nếu chọn đúng khung giờ. Mưa rào thường đến vào buổi chiều, nên đi sớm và theo dõi báo mưa theo giờ.
Làm sao để cả nhà không quên đồ?
Chia sẻ danh sách đồ cần mang theo dự báo cho mọi người từ tối hôm trước.
Dự báo có luôn chính xác không?
Không. Dự báo và gợi ý chỉ mang tính tham khảo; hãy xem lại vào sáng hôm đi.

en.title: Weather for the whole family: planning a weekend outing that avoids rain and harsh sun
en.meta: Planning a family weekend outing but worried about sudden rain or harsh sun? How to read the 7-day forecast, pick a time window and pack for everyone, step by step from midweek to the morning you leave.
en.h1: Family weather: planning a weekend outing around the forecast
en.lead: A family outing is different from going out alone: there are grandparents, small children, a car full of bags, and one afternoon shower can ruin the whole trip. So checking the weather should start midweek, not on the morning you leave.
en.answer: Check the weather at three points: midweek, look at the 7-day forecast to choose the day; the evening before, check tomorrow's forecast for rain or a colder or hotter day; and on the morning you leave, use the hourly chart to pick a window with little rain and low UV. Pack to the forecast and share the list with the whole family so nobody forgets anything.
paras: The further ahead a forecast looks, the less certain it is, so midweek is only for choosing between Saturday and Sunday, or deciding between an indoor or outdoor outing. Do not fix times yet.
The evening before is when you lock the plan. If rain is likely tomorrow afternoon, move the outdoor part to the morning; if it will be hotter, pack extra water, hats and sunscreen for everyone.

On the morning you leave, look at the 24-hour temperature chart and hourly details to choose when to be outside. In many parts of Vietnam, the rainy season brings afternoon showers, so leaving early and heading back before the rain is often the safe choice.

Lumi Weather turns these factors into an outdoor score from 0 to 100, based on feels-like temperature, chance of rain, UV, wind and sky conditions; tap the score to see each factor. The app shows the best time window to go out, suggests what to wear and whether you need an umbrella or sunscreen, and offers a shareable packing list for the family. You can also save places you visit often, such as the grandparents' home or a park, to check the weather there.

Pack to the forecast: umbrella or raincoat, hats, sunscreen, drinking water.

en.fits: Lumi Weather suits families who often plan weekend outings, trips to the grandparents' or park visits with the kids: an outdoor score from 0 to 100 with clear reasons, the best time window to go out, hourly and 7-day forecasts, alerts before rain, what-to-wear suggestions and a shareable packing list. Save several places, with Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch. No account, no ads; a one-time in-app unlock opens every feature, with no subscription.
faq: How far ahead should I check the weather before a trip?
Check the 7-day forecast midweek to choose the day, then lock the plan the evening before, when the forecast is more certain.
Is a weekend outing a good idea in the rainy season?
Yes, if you pick the right window. Showers often come in the afternoon, so leave early and follow the hourly rain forecast.
How do we make sure nobody forgets anything?
Share a packing list based on the forecast with everyone the evening before.
Is the forecast always accurate?
No. Forecasts and suggestions are for reference only; check again on the morning you leave.

loc.title: Passbild: Die biometrischen Regeln vor dem Einreichen prüfen
loc.meta: Ein Passbild scheitert meist an Kleinigkeiten: Kopf zu klein, Schatten im Hintergrund, Lächeln, Brillenreflexe. So prüfen Sie Größe, Ausdruck und Licht, bevor Sie das Foto abgeben.
loc.h1: Passbild prüfen: Größe, Gesicht, Hintergrund und Licht
loc.lead: Ein biometrisches Passbild wird nicht nach Schönheit beurteilt, sondern danach, ob eine Software das Gesicht zuverlässig vermessen kann. Deshalb sind die Regeln so genau, und deshalb lohnt sich ein kurzer Check vor dem Einreichen.
loc.answer: Ein Passbild im Format 35×45 mm zeigt das Gesicht frontal, mit neutralem Ausdruck, geschlossenem Mund und offenen Augen, vor einem einfarbig hellen Hintergrund ohne Schatten; das Gesicht nimmt den Großteil der Bildhöhe ein. Für Reisepass und Personalausweis in Deutschland gilt zusätzlich: Das Foto muss digital übermittelt werden.
paras: Die häufigsten Fehler sind Proportionen. Das Format 35×45 mm allein reicht nicht; entscheidend ist, wie groß der Kopf darin ist. Von Kinn bis Scheitel sollte das Gesicht ungefähr 32 bis 36 mm hoch sein, mittig sitzen und gerade in die Kamera schauen. Ein zu weit entfernt aufgenommenes Foto, das nachträglich zugeschnitten wird, wirkt schnell unscharf.

Danach kommen Licht und Hintergrund. Der Hintergrund soll einfarbig und hell sein, meist ein neutrales Hellgrau, ohne Muster und ohne Schatten hinter dem Kopf. Am besten stellen Sie sich mit etwas Abstand vor eine helle Wand und fotografieren gegenüber einem Fenster mit gleichmäßigem Tageslicht. Brillen dürfen keine Reflexe zeigen und die Augen nicht verdecken; Kopfbedeckungen sind in der Regel nur aus religiösen Gründen erlaubt.

Wichtig für Deutschland: Seit dem 1. Mai 2025 nimmt das Bürgeramt für Reisepass und Personalausweis nur noch digital übermittelte Fotos an, etwa vom zertifizierten Fotografen oder vom Terminal in der Behörde. Ein selbst gemachtes Passbild brauchen Sie daher vor allem für Visa anderer Länder, Bewerbungen oder andere Anträge. Snapport Lite schneidet Ihr Porträt dafür exakt zu, zum Beispiel auf 35×45 mm, mit Hilfslinien für Scheitel, Augenlinie und Kinn und einem weißen oder hellgrauen Hintergrund. Ob ein Foto angenommen wird, entscheidet immer die Stelle, bei der Sie es einreichen.

Nein, verlangt wird ein neutraler Gesichtsausdruck mit geschlossenem Mund. Ein leichtes, natürliches Gesicht ist in Ordnung, ein Lächeln mit Zähnen nicht.
Kann ich für den Personalausweis noch ein ausgedrucktes Foto abgeben?
Seit dem 1. Mai 2025 nicht mehr: Für Personalausweis und Reisepass werden nur digital übermittelte Fotos angenommen, etwa vom zertifizierten Fotografen oder vom Terminal im Bürgeramt.

en.title: Passport photo: check the biometric rules before you submit
en.meta: A passport photo usually fails on small things: head too small, a shadow on the background, a smile, glare in glasses. How to check size, expression and light before you hand it in.
en.h1: Checking a passport photo: size, face, background and light
en.lead: A biometric passport photo is judged not on looks but on whether software can measure the face reliably. That is why the rules are so precise, and why a quick check before submitting pays off.
en.answer: A 35×45 mm photo shows the face straight on with a neutral expression, mouth closed and eyes open, against a plain light background with no shadows, with the face filling most of the frame height. In Germany, passport and ID card photos must also be submitted digitally.
paras: The commonest mistakes are proportions. The 35×45 mm format is not enough on its own; what matters is how large the head is inside it. From chin to crown the face should be roughly 32 to 36 mm tall, centred and looking straight at the camera. A photo taken from too far away and cropped afterwards quickly looks soft.

Next come light and background. The background should be plain and light, usually a neutral light grey, with no pattern and no shadow behind the head. Stand a little away from a light wall and shoot facing a window with even daylight. Glasses must not show glare or cover the eyes, and head coverings are generally allowed only for religious reasons.

Important for Germany: since 1 May 2025 citizens' offices accept only digitally transmitted photos for passports and ID cards, for example from a certified photographer or the terminal at the office. A home-made photo is therefore mainly for other countries' visas, job applications or other forms. Snapport Lite crops your portrait to the exact size, for example 35×45 mm, with head-top, eye-line and chin guides and a white or light grey background. Acceptance is always decided by the office you submit to.

faq: Can I smile in a passport photo?
No. A neutral expression with the mouth closed is required; a relaxed natural face is fine, a toothy smile is not.
Can I still hand in a printed photo for a German ID card?
Not since 1 May 2025: for ID cards and passports only digitally transmitted photos are accepted, for example from a certified photographer or the terminal at the citizens' office.
Does Snapport Lite guarantee my photo will be accepted?

loc.title: iPhone・iPad を置き時計にするには？机・棚・枕元の置き方と設定
loc.meta: 使っていない iPhone や iPad は置き時計になります。置き場所に合わせて向きと充電経路を決め、画面が消えない設定、夜の暗い表示、遠くから読める文字盤を選べば、机でも棚でも枕元でも使えます。
loc.h1: iPhone・iPad を置き時計にする方法：机・棚・枕元それぞれの置き方
loc.lead: 引き出しに眠っている iPad や機種変更前の iPhone は、置き時計としてもう一度働けます。ただ、そのまま立てるだけでは画面が消えたり、夜に眩しかったりします。
loc.answer: 置き場所を先に決め、充電ケーブルが届く向き（机なら横向き、棚や枕元なら縦向きも可）でスタンドに立て、充電中は画面が消えない設定にします。枕元では夜だけ暗い表示に切り替え、離れた場所から読める大きな数字の文字盤を選びます。
paras: 置き時計にするときに最初に決めるのは「どこに置くか」です。机の上なら目線より少し下に置けるので横向きで大きく表示すると読みやすく、棚の上なら部屋のどこからでも見えるよう全画面の数字が向いています。枕元は寝たまま見る角度になるため、低めのスタンドで画面を少し上向きにすると見やすくなります。
次に考えるのは電源と明るさです。iPhone や iPad は操作しないと画面が消えるので、時計にするなら充電ケーブルをつないだまま置ける場所が前提になります。寝室では、白い画面は思った以上に眩しく感じます。夜だけ黒い背景に控えめな色で時刻を出せると、明かりを消した部屋でも邪魔になりません。
Stay Clock は iPhone と iPad を常時点灯の置き時計にするアプリです。充電中だけ点灯、バッテリー残量の下限を保ちながら点灯、システム設定に従う、の三つから選べ、夜は真っ黒な背景に赤い文字盤へ切り替えられます。縦向き・横向きのどちらにも対応し、有機 EL 画面向けにピクセルを少しずつずらすパネル保護もあります。アカウント、広告、追跡、通信はありません。

en.title: How to turn an iPhone or iPad into a table clock for the desk, shelf or bedside
en.meta: A spare iPhone or iPad makes a good table clock. Pick the spot, set the orientation and charging path, keep the screen awake, dim it at night and choose a face readable from across the room.
en.h1: How to use an iPhone or iPad as a table clock: desk, shelf and bedside
en.lead: The iPad in a drawer or the iPhone you replaced can work again as a table clock. Just propping it up is not enough, though: the screen goes dark, or glows too bright at night.
en.answer: Decide where it will sit first, stand it in the orientation that lets the charging cable reach (landscape on a desk, portrait is fine on a shelf or nightstand), and keep the screen on while charging. At the bedside, switch to a dim display at night and choose a face with large digits you can read from across the room.
paras: The first decision is where the clock will live. On a desk it sits a little below eye level, so a large landscape display reads best; on a shelf, full screen digits let you see it from anywhere in the room. At the bedside you look at it lying down, so a low stand that tilts the screen slightly upward helps.

Next come power and brightness. An iPhone or iPad turns its screen off when idle, so a clock needs a spot where it can stay plugged in. In a bedroom, a white screen feels brighter than you expect; showing the time in a quiet color on black at night keeps it out of the way with the lights off.

Stay Clock turns an iPhone or iPad into an always-on table clock. You can keep it awake while charging, always on with a battery floor, or follow the system, and switch to a dim red face on true black at night. It works in portrait and landscape, and includes Panel Care with gentle pixel shifting for OLED screens. No account, no ads, no tracking and no network.

loc.title: Révision TOEIC : partir de vos trois compétences les plus faibles
loc.meta: Réviser le TOEIC en enchaînant des séries au hasard fait perdre du temps sans faire monter le score. Voici comment repérer vos trois points faibles, les travailler un par un et vérifier le progrès au jour 30.
loc.h1: Révision TOEIC : trois points faibles d'abord, le reste ensuite
loc.lead: La plupart des révisions TOEIC ratent pour la même raison : on refait ce qu'on sait déjà faire, parce que c'est agréable, et on évite ce qui coûte vraiment des points.
loc.answer: Pour réviser le TOEIC efficacement, commencez par un court diagnostic qui mélange grammaire, écoute et lecture, gardez les trois compétences où vous perdez le plus de points, travaillez-en une par jour, puis refaites le même contrôle au bout de 30 jours pour comparer.
paras: Le TOEIC Listening & Reading compte 200 questions en deux heures : environ 45 minutes d'écoute, puis 75 minutes de lecture. Avec un tel volume, deux ou trois faiblesses précises suffisent à bloquer un score : confondre des temps verbaux dans la partie 5, manquer la question pendant qu'on lit les réponses à l'écoute, ou ne pas finir la partie 7. Réviser « un peu de tout » dilue le temps sur ce qui marche déjà.

Aim990 commence par un diagnostic de 8 minutes : une vingtaine de tâches de grammaire, d'écoute et de lecture qui estiment votre palier d'entraînement et désignent vos trois compétences les plus faibles. Ces trois compétences deviennent une ordonnance écrite : quoi réparer en premier, pourquoi cela vous coûte des points et combien de temps y consacrer. Chaque jour, une seule compétence prescrite, en trois phases : diagnostiquer, réparer, vérifier.

Pour la gestion du temps, Aim990 propose de la grammaire chronométrée avec indices de 15 secondes et un entraînement sur les textes longs ; pour l'oreille, la dictée et la répétition guidée avec la voix de l'appareil ; pour le vocabulaire, la répétition espacée avec le sens dans votre langue. Au jour 30, les mêmes compétences sont mesurées à nouveau et vous comparez directement le jour 1 et le jour 30. Si l'examen approche, le mode urgence resserre la révision sur les 1, 3, 7 ou 14 derniers jours.

en.title: TOEIC revision: start from your three weakest skills
en.meta: Revising for the TOEIC with random practice sets burns time without moving the score. Here is how to find your three weakest skills, work on them one at a time and check progress on day 30.
en.h1: TOEIC revision: three weak spots first, everything else later
en.lead: Most TOEIC revision fails for the same reason: you redo what you already do well, because it feels good, and avoid what actually costs you points.
en.answer: To revise for the TOEIC efficiently, start with a short diagnostic mixing grammar, listening and reading, keep the three skills where you lose the most points, work on one per day, then repeat the same check after 30 days and compare.
paras: The TOEIC Listening & Reading test has 200 questions in two hours: about 45 minutes of listening, then 75 minutes of reading. At that volume, two or three specific weaknesses are enough to cap a score: mixing up verb tenses in part 5, missing the question while reading the options in listening, or not finishing part 7. Revising a bit of everything spreads your time over what already works.

Aim990 starts with an 8-minute diagnostic: about twenty grammar, listening and reading tasks that estimate your practice level and name your three weakest skills. Those three skills become a written prescription: what to fix first, why it costs you points and how long it should take. Each day you work on one prescribed skill in three phases: diagnose, repair, verify.

For pacing, Aim990 has timed grammar with 15-second hints and timing practice on long passages; for listening, dictation and guided repetition with the device voice; for vocabulary, spaced repetition with meanings in your language. On day 30 the same skills are measured again and you compare day 1 and day 30 directly. If the exam is close, crunch mode narrows revision to the final 1, 3, 7 or 14 days.

Can you name your three weakest skills, and the order to fix them in?
Do you practise pacing, not just getting answers right?
Do you have a fixed-date check to see whether the work paid off?
Can you revise offline, on the train or on a break?
steps: Take the 8-minute diagnostic somewhere quiet, without stopping.
Read the prescription: your three weakest skills and the suggested order.
Each day, work on a single skill: diagnose, repair, verify.
Look at the accuracy and pacing log at the end of each week.
On day 30, repeat the check and compare it with day 1.

Finish the 75 minutes without guessing the end

It runs on iPhone and Apple Watch, with no account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking, and daily practice works offline. TOEIC is a registered trademark of ETS; Aim990 is not affiliated with or endorsed by ETS, its exercises are original unofficial content, and every level is an estimate, never a guaranteed score.
faq: How long should TOEIC revision take?
It depends on the gap to your target. A 30-day cycle focused on three skills, with a check on day 1 and day 30, already shows whether the method works for you.
Should I sit a full mock test every week?
A full test measures; it does not build skill. Between measurements, working on one precise skill per day moves the score more.
Does Aim990 use real TOEIC questions?
No. All exercises are original and unofficial, written for TOEIC-style Listening & Reading preparation.

loc.title: iPhone 電池健康：最大容量數字代表什麼、怎麼看它的變化
loc.meta: 設定裡的電池健康只給你一個最大容量百分比。這頁說明這個數字代表什麼、掉到多少該注意，以及怎麼把它記下來看出趨勢。
loc.h1: iPhone 電池健康：看懂最大容量，再看它怎麼變
loc.lead: 很多人查「電池健康」是因為手機突然變得很耗電，打開設定看到 86% 卻不知道這算好還是壞。
loc.answer: iPhone 的電池健康主要看「設定 › 電池」裡的最大容量，它是電池現在能存的電量和新品時相比的百分比。數字越低，一次充飽能用的時間越短；接近 80% 時就值得留意。單看一次數字不夠，要隔一段時間記錄，才看得出它掉得快不快。
paras: 最大容量是電池化學老化的結果：充電循環次數、長時間待在滿電、充電時發熱，都會讓它慢慢下降。蘋果的說明是，iPhone 電池設計在一定的完整充電循環後仍保有約 80% 原始容量（iPhone 14 及更早機型約 500 次，iPhone 15 起約 1000 次）。所以同樣是 85%，用了半年和用了三年的手機，代表的意思不一樣。

設定只告訴你「現在」的最大容量，看不到它怎麼變。BattAI 在你平常用手機時持續記錄電量、充電與發熱，把電池狀態整理成 0–100 的健康分數，分成優異、良好、普通、需要保養、檢查維修五級，並逐項列出評分依據：容量 40%、循環次數 25%、裝置使用年限 10%、熱暴露 10%、充電習慣 15%。最大容量要你在「設定 › 電池」查看後輸入，或從系統「分析資料」檔匯入，BattAI 自己讀不到這個數值。
輸入過的最大容量會畫成趨勢圖，附 95% 信賴區間；讀值相隔至少 30 天後，還會顯示每月容量變化。每次充電有充電保養分數，充電習慣分放電深度、充電上限、過夜充電、充電時發熱、充電頻率五項評分並給建議，例如合適時把上限設在 80–90%。這些分數與預估是算出的參考值，不是官方或原廠數值。
look: 你知道自己現在的最大容量，以及上次看是什麼時候嗎？
最大容量是慢慢掉，還是最近幾個月掉得特別快？
手機常在充電時發燙，或整晚停在 100% 嗎？
每小時掉電多少？是某個時段特別耗電嗎？
換機或賣舊機時，拿得出看得懂的電池狀態說明嗎？

把這個數字輸入 BattAI，或從「分析資料」檔匯入最大容量與循環次數。
看健康分數的扣分原因，先處理比重最大的一項。
照充電習慣建議調整，例如合適時把充電上限設在 80–90%。
隔 30 天再輸入一次最大容量，看每月容量變化。

同樣容量，循環少代表老化慢
充電時發熱、過夜充電、充電上限
最容易自己改善的部分
loc.fits: BattAI 適合覺得手機變耗電、想知道電池健康是否正常，或準備換機、賣舊機、買二手機前想把電池狀態說清楚的人。資料只存在這台手機，不用帳號，沒有分析、追蹤、第三方 SDK 或網路請求。分數與預估是參考值，不代表電池還能用多久的承諾；熱狀態指整部手機，而非電池溫度。

接近 80% 時值得留意；但還要看你一天要充幾次、會不會突然關機。先記錄一段時間的趨勢，再決定比較準。

一直充到 100% 會傷電池嗎？
長時間停在滿電和充電時發熱都會加快老化。BattAI 會依你的充電紀錄給建議，例如合適時把上限設在 80–90%。

en.title: iPhone battery health: what the percentage means and how to track it
en.meta: Battery Health in Settings gives you one Maximum Capacity number. Here is what it means, when to start paying attention, and how to log it so you can see the trend.
en.h1: iPhone battery health: read Maximum Capacity, then watch how it moves
en.lead: Many people look up battery health because their phone suddenly drains faster, open Settings, see 86% and have no idea whether that is good or bad.
en.answer: iPhone battery health mainly comes down to Maximum Capacity in Settings › Battery: how much charge the battery holds now compared with when it was new. The lower it is, the shorter a full charge lasts; near 80% it is worth watching. One reading is not enough; log it over time to see how fast it is falling.
paras: Maximum Capacity drops as the battery ages chemically: charge cycles, long stretches at full charge and heat while charging all wear it down. Apple says iPhone batteries are designed to keep about 80% of their original capacity after a certain number of complete charge cycles (around 500 for iPhone 14 and earlier, around 1000 from iPhone 15). So 85% on a six-month-old phone means something different from 85% on a three-year-old one.

Settings only shows today's Maximum Capacity, not how it changes. BattAI keeps a record of charge level, charging and heat while you use your phone, and turns battery status into a 0–100 health score in five grades from excellent to needs service, listing what shapes it: capacity 40%, cycle count 25%, device age 10%, heat exposure 10% and charging habits 15%. You enter Maximum Capacity after checking Settings › Battery, or import it from a system Analytics file; BattAI cannot read that value itself.

Your Maximum Capacity readings become a trend chart with a 95% confidence band, and once readings are at least 30 days apart it shows monthly capacity change. Every charge gets a charge care score, and charging habits are rated on depth of discharge, charge limit, overnight charging, heat while charging and charging frequency, with suggestions such as using 80–90% when it suits you. Scores and estimates are calculated references, not official or manufacturer values.

Is it falling slowly, or faster over the last few months?
Does your phone often get hot while charging, or sit at 100% overnight?
How much charge do you lose per hour, and is one time of day worse?
When you sell or replace the phone, can you show a clear battery report?
steps: Open Settings › Battery and note Maximum Capacity.
Enter it in BattAI, or import Maximum Capacity and cycle count from an Analytics file.
Check what lowers your health score and deal with the biggest factor first.
Adjust charging habits as suggested, for example an 80–90% limit when it suits you.
Enter Maximum Capacity again after 30 days to see the monthly change.

From an imported file or manual entry

en.fits: BattAI fits people whose phone seems to drain faster, who want to know whether their battery health is normal, or who want a clear battery picture before replacing, selling or buying a used iPhone. Data stays on the phone, with no account, analytics, tracking, third-party SDKs or network requests. Scores and estimates are references, not a promise of how long the battery will last, and thermal state refers to the whole phone, not battery temperature.
faq: At what battery health should I replace the battery?
Near 80% is worth watching, but also consider how often you charge per day and whether the phone shuts down unexpectedly. Logging the trend for a while gives a better answer.
Can BattAI read Maximum Capacity directly?

No. Public system interfaces only provide charge level, charging state and the phone's thermal state; Maximum Capacity and cycle count come from what you enter after checking Settings or import from an Analytics file.
Does charging to 100% every time hurt the battery?
Long periods at full charge and heat while charging both speed up ageing. BattAI suggests changes from your charging history, such as an 80–90% limit when it suits you.

loc.title: ATS resume builder: what it should do before you hit Apply
loc.meta: An ATS resume builder should do more than fill a template. Check the format, the headings and the keywords an applicant tracking system reads, then export a file it can parse.
loc.h1: ATS resume builder: four things it must get right
loc.lead: Most resumes that vanish after you hit Apply were not rejected by a person. The applicant tracking system read them badly, and nobody ever saw the experience inside.
loc.answer: A good ATS resume builder gives you a single-column layout with standard headings, exports a PDF with real selectable text, checks whether the keywords from the job posting appear in your resume, and lets you keep a tailored version for each job. Score the resume before you apply, not after a silent rejection.
paras: Applicant tracking systems pull text out of your file and sort it into fields such as experience, education and skills. Two columns, text inside images, unusual section names or a scanned PDF can all break that step, so a strong candidate shows up with an empty skills field. The safest format is plain: one column, standard headings, real text you can select and copy.

CV Desk is built around that check. It gives your resume an instant 0–100 ATS score on your iPhone with clear, tappable fixes, so the system reads your experience and keywords correctly. Then it exports a single-column PDF with real, selectable text and standard headings, or an editable Word (.docx) file you can open in Word, Pages or Google Docs with the same fonts, colors and layout.

Because every posting uses different keywords, keep one resume per job: CV Desk holds multiple resumes so you can tailor each one, with a live preview as you type and clean templates with accent colors. A header photo is optional and off by default, which keeps the file ATS-safe. Your resume stays on your iPhone with no account, and it works in airplane mode. The ATS score is an on-device estimate; results vary by employer system.

Does the exported PDF contain real, selectable text?
Does the builder show which fixes would raise your ATS score?

Check the 0–100 ATS score and tap each suggested fix.

Export a single-column PDF, or an editable .docx if the posting asks for Word.
Open the PDF and select the text to confirm it is real text, then apply.

loc.fits: CV Desk fits job seekers who apply online and worry that an applicant tracking system will filter their resume out before a person reads it. It runs on iPhone, keeps every resume on the device with no account and no ads, and includes Siri and Shortcuts to jump straight in. Light and dark mode, sharing, saving to Files and AirPrint are built in.
faq: Is a PDF or a Word file better for an ATS?
A single-column PDF with real, selectable text is read correctly by most systems. If a posting asks for Word, export an editable .docx instead.
Does a high ATS score guarantee an interview?
No. CV Desk's ATS score is an on-device estimate of parse-safety and keyword coverage; results vary by employer system, and the content still has to match the job.
Should I add a photo to my resume?
In many markets an ATS-safe resume leaves the photo out. In CV Desk the header photo is optional and off by default.

loc.title: Everyday phrases: learn the reply, not just the line
loc.meta: Lists of everyday phrases help until someone answers you. Here is how to learn complete phrases together with the replies that usually follow, by real situation and level.
loc.h1: Everyday phrases: practise the whole exchange
loc.lead: You can say the phrase you memorised. Then the waiter, the pharmacist or your new colleague replies, and the conversation stops there.
loc.answer: Everyday phrases stick when you learn them as complete exchanges in real situations: the line you say, the reply you are likely to hear and what you say next. Pick the situations you will actually meet, start with essentials, listen to each phrase aloud and keep only the ones worth revisiting.
paras: People searching for everyday phrases usually already know plenty of single words. What breaks a conversation is the second turn: you ask for the bill, and the answer is a question about how you want to pay. Learning phrases in pairs, with the natural reply next to them, prepares you for the part a phrasebook list leaves out.

DailyMate teaches complete sentences and the natural replies that follow: 8,400 practical phrases in 47 learning languages, organised into 14 everyday topics and 84 real-life situations, from greetings, food and shopping to work, health and travel. Each topic has 200 beginner, 200 intermediate and 200 advanced phrases, so you can begin with everyday essentials and move on to fuller and more precise expressions.

Hear each complete phrase through the system voice matched to your chosen language, save the phrases worth revisiting, and keep favourites and progress separately for each language you learn. The interactive Home Screen widget lets you view a phrase, move on or save it, and Apple Watch keeps phrases, system-voice listening, favourites and progress close by. DailyMate is a paid app: one purchase includes iPhone, iPad, the widget and Apple Watch, with no subscription.

Start at beginner level and read each phrase together with its reply.

loc.title: AI brief: give the AI the full context in one clean message
loc.meta: An AI brief is the context you hand an AI before you ask: the goal, the facts and where each fact came from. Here is how to build one from screenshots, PDFs and notes, and check it first.
loc.h1: AI brief: goal, facts and sources before the question
loc.lead: When an AI answer misses the point, the question is rarely the problem. The AI was missing half the context, or got a fact you never checked.
loc.answer: An AI brief is one message that gives an AI everything it needs before your question: what you want, the facts that matter, where each fact came from and what is still unclear. Build it from your actual files, check every fact and remove personal details before you paste it into any AI chat.
paras: People usually paste context in pieces: a screenshot here, a paragraph from a PDF there, a note typed from memory. The AI then fills the gaps on its own. A brief fixes that by putting the goal first, then the facts with their sources, then conflicts and open questions, so the AI knows what is established and what is not.

AI Brief turns screenshots, PDFs, files, copied text, notes and links into one well-organized AI prompt, with the goal, facts and sources sorted. Text recognition, PDF reading, duplicate checks, fact extraction and privacy detection run on your device with Apple frameworks. Every fact keeps its source and confidence, so you can correct anything that needs context, and the app points out facts, conflicts and open questions before the AI sees them.

Detected personal details are never removed automatically: you decide for each item whether to keep, replace or remove it, and replacements and removals are applied at export. The finished brief has structured headings and source-ready formatting; copy it in one tap and paste it into any AI chat. Version history keeps every earlier draft within reach, and templates cover technical problems, support requests, document analysis, study material and meeting follow-ups.
look: Does the brief state the goal before the details?
Can you see where each fact came from, and how sure it is?
Are conflicts and open questions listed instead of hidden?
Did you decide what happens to every personal detail before sharing?
Can you reuse the same brief later without rebuilding it?
steps: Add the screenshots, PDFs, files and notes the AI needs to see.
Write the goal in one sentence: what you want back from the AI.
Check each extracted fact, its source and its confidence; correct what is off.
Keep, replace or remove each detected personal detail.
Copy the finished brief and paste it into the AI chat you use.
rows: Tells the AI what a good answer looks like
Lets you check before the AI builds on it
Stops the AI from guessing silently
loc.fits: AI Brief fits people who regularly paste screenshots, PDFs and notes into AI chats and want the context complete and checked first: for technical problems, support requests, document analysis, study material or meeting follow-ups. AI Brief does not include third-party ads, tracking, analytics or content telemetry, and it never promises anonymity; review the brief before sending it to any AI service.
faq: What is the difference between an AI brief and a prompt?
A prompt is the question. A brief is the context in front of it: the goal, the facts with sources and the open questions, so the answer is built on what you actually know.
Does AI Brief send my files to an AI?
No. Text recognition, PDF reading and privacy detection run on your device. You copy the finished brief and paste it into the AI chat yourself.
Does it remove personal data automatically?
No. Detected details are never removed automatically; you choose to keep, replace or remove each one, and the changes are applied at export.

loc.h1: ติดตามประจำเดือน: จดน้อยแต่จดทุกรอบ
loc.lead: หลายคนเริ่มติดตามประจำเดือนด้วยความตั้งใจ จดละเอียดอยู่สองสัปดาห์ แล้วก็หยุด จนรอบถัดมาไม่มีข้อมูลให้เทียบ
loc.answer: การติดตามประจำเดือนที่ได้ผล คือจดวันแรกและวันสุดท้ายของประจำเดือนให้ครบทุกรอบ แล้วเสริมด้วยอาการสั้น ๆ เช่น ปริมาณ ปวดประจำเดือน และอารมณ์ ยิ่งมีหลายรอบ การคาดการณ์รอบเดือนถัดไป ช่วงเจริญพันธุ์ และวันไข่ตกก็ยิ่งใกล้ความจริงมากขึ้น
paras: รอบเดือนของแต่ละคนไม่เท่ากัน และอาจเปลี่ยนไปตามความเครียด การนอน หรือการเดินทาง ช่วงสองสามรอบแรกที่เริ่มจด การคาดการณ์จึงยังอิงค่าทั่วไปมากกว่าข้อมูลของคุณเอง สิ่งสำคัญไม่ใช่การจดให้ละเอียดที่สุด แต่คือการจดวันเริ่มและวันสิ้นสุดให้ครบทุกครั้ง เพราะนั่นคือข้อมูลที่ใช้คำนวณความยาวรอบ

en.title: Period tracking: what to log each day so predictions get closer
en.meta: Started tracking your period and not sure what to record? Here is what to log, why early predictions are still rough, and how to keep the data on your own device.
en.h1: Period tracking: log a little, but log every cycle
en.lead: Many people start tracking their period with good intentions, log everything for two weeks and then stop, so the next cycle has nothing to compare against.
en.answer: Period tracking works when you record the first and last day of every period without gaps, plus a few quick notes such as flow, cramps and mood. The more cycles you log, the closer predictions of your next period, fertile window and ovulation day get to reality.
paras: Every cycle is different and can shift with stress, sleep or travel. In the first two or three cycles you track, predictions still lean on general averages more than on your own data. The key is not logging as much detail as possible but recording the start and end date every time, because that is what cycle length is calculated from.

Cyca lets you log your period and estimates your next period, fertile window and ovulation day, all on one calm calendar that adjusts every time you log. Cramps, flow and moods take seconds to log, so a daily entry never feels like a chore.

A Daily Body Forecast reads where you are in your cycle and suggests how your energy, mood and skin may be today, and you can turn on reminders before your next period and fertile window, plus a daily logging reminder. All data stays on the device, with no account, no cloud and no tracking, and the app works offline.

Are your symptom notes short enough to log every day?
Do predictions adjust every time you add new data?
Is there a reminder before your period so you can prepare?
Does your cycle data stay on your device, or go to a cloud?
steps: Log the first day of your period as soon as it starts.
Note flow, cramps and mood briefly each day.
Log the last day when your period ends.
Turn on the reminder before your next period and the daily logging reminder.
After two or three cycles, check the calendar to see how long and how regular your cycle is.

Cyca provides wellness and planning estimates and is not a medical device or a form of contraception; if your cycle is irregular or the pain is severe, see a doctor.

The more the better. Early predictions lean on general averages; once you have several cycles of your own, Cyca adapts to your real rhythm every time you log.
Can I use Cyca as contraception?
No. Cyca provides wellness and planning estimates and is not a medical device or a form of contraception.
Is my period data sent anywhere?
No. Cyca has no account, no cloud and no tracking; your data stays on your device and the app works offline.

loc.title: 計算機主題怎麼挑：好看之外，還要按得準、看得清
loc.meta: 想換一台有主題的計算機，先看四件事：數字清不清楚、按鍵好不好按、算過的結果找不找得回來、主畫面能不能直接算。
loc.h1: 計算機主題：先好用，再好看
loc.lead: 很多人換主題計算機，是因為內建計算機太單調；用了一週又換回去，是因為好看的那款數字太小、按鍵太擠。
loc.answer: 挑計算機主題時，先確認數字和按鍵在這個主題下一樣清楚好按，再看它能不能記住算過的結果、能不能在主畫面小工具直接算。主題是每天都會看到的部分，但真正讓你留下來的是算得順、找得回來。
paras: 主題好不好用，最容易在三個地方露餡：深色或半透明的按鍵上數字對比太低、按鍵形狀做得太花讓人按偏，以及結果字太細，在戶外或強光下看不清。換主題前，用它實際算一次分帳或折扣，比只看截圖準得多。
CalDaily 內建一百款按鍵主題，從溫潤的陶瓷到深邃的稜鏡，每一款都有自己的按鍵形狀、材質與光線，隨時可以換。主畫面小工具不開 App 也能算，想算就在主畫面直接按。
它也是一台會記住每一筆結果的計算機：結果可以命名，下週直接搜尋那次分帳的晚餐或比過的貸款，不用重算。紀錄會自動依日期分組、可依工具篩選，需要時也能匯出 CSV 放進試算表。小費分帳、折扣與稅、貸款月付、單位換算、日期差與工作天、行程油費等 8 種工具都在同一個 App 裡，常用的稅率與人數設一次就好。
look: 這個主題下，數字和結果在強光下還看得清楚嗎？
按鍵形狀好看之外，按起來會不會按偏？
算過的結果能不能命名、之後搜尋得到？
主畫面小工具能不能不開 App 就直接算？
有沒有廣告、需不需要帳號？
steps: 先挑三款喜歡的主題。
每一款都實際算一次分帳或折扣，看數字清不清楚、按鍵順不順手。
留下最順手的那款，把小工具放到主畫面。
常用的稅率與分帳人數先設好。
重要的結果順手命名，之後用搜尋找回來。
rows: 每天看到的部分，決定你想不想打開
數字對比與結果字大小
看錯一位數，好看也沒用

loc.title: 사귄 날 계산: 첫날을 1일로 세는 법과 22일·100일·1주년 날짜
loc.meta: 사귄 날 계산은 첫날을 1일로 세는지부터 정해야 합니다. 22일·100일·200일·1000일이 언제인지 계산하는 법과, 기념일을 놓치지 않게 알림과 위젯을 맞추는 법을 정리했습니다.
loc.h1: 사귄 날 계산: 첫날이 1일, 100일은 99일 뒤
loc.lead: 100일 케이크를 예약했는데 상대는 어제가 100일이었다고 말합니다. 대부분 계산 실수가 아니라 첫날을 세는 방식의 차이입니다.
loc.answer: 한국에서 사귄 날을 셀 때는 사귄 첫날을 1일로 칩니다. 그래서 100일은 사귄 날에서 99일을 더한 날이고, N일째는 사귄 날 + (N−1)일입니다. 1주년, 2주년 같은 주년은 일수가 아니라 매년 같은 날짜입니다.
paras: 달력 계산은 두 날짜의 차이를 구하기 때문에 사귄 날 당일이 0일이 됩니다. 하지만 커플 기념일은 사귄 날을 1일로 세는 관습이라, 달력 차이에 1을 더해야 흔히 말하는 날짜가 나옵니다. 예를 들어 2026년 11월 7일에 사귀기 시작했다면 22일은 11월 28일, 100일은 2027년 2월 14일, 200일은 5월 25일, 300일은 9월 2일, 1000일은 2029년 8월 2일입니다. 1주년은 2027년 11월 7일입니다.

손으로 세면 달마다 일수가 달라서 달이 바뀌는 지점에서 하루씩 틀리기 쉽습니다. CountDaysNow는 지난날·오늘·다가올 날을 세 가지 보기로 나누어 정확한 날짜 수를 보여 주고, 날짜를 더하거나 빼고 비교하는 계산기가 있어서 사귄 날에 99일을 더한 날짜를 바로 확인할 수 있습니다. 앱에서 표시하는 숫자가 첫날을 0일로 세는지 1일로 세는지는 처음에 한 번만 확인해 두세요.

기념일은 계산보다 챙기는 쪽이 더 어렵습니다. CountDaysNow는 7일·3일·1일 전과 당일, 100일, 그리고 매년 돌아오는 날에 알려 주고, 홈 화면 위젯과 잠금화면, 다이내믹 아일랜드에 남은 날을 보여 줍니다. 하나의 디데이를 다른 CountDaysNow 사용자와 함께 갱신할 수 있고, 공유 카드는 정사각형·세로형·스토리 세 가지 비율로 내보낼 수 있습니다.

100일 날짜를 사귄 날 + 99일로 계산했나요?

en.title: Counting days since you started dating: the Korean day-one rule
en.meta: Counting couple days starts with one question: is the first day day 1? Here is how to work out 22, 100, 200 and 1,000 days, and how to set reminders and widgets so you never miss one.
en.h1: Couple day count: the first day is day 1, so day 100 is 99 days later
en.lead: You booked the day-100 cake, and your partner says day 100 was yesterday. Usually nobody miscounted; you just started counting from different days.
en.answer: In Korea, couple days are counted with the first day as day 1. So day 100 is the start date plus 99 days, and day N is the start date plus N−1 days. Anniversaries such as the first and second year fall on the same calendar date each year, not after a fixed number of days.
paras: Calendar arithmetic gives the difference between two dates, so the start date itself is day 0. The couple-anniversary custom counts the start date as day 1, so you add one to the calendar difference. For example, if you started dating on 7 November 2026, day 22 is 28 November, day 100 is 14 February 2027, day 200 is 25 May, day 300 is 2 September and day 1,000 is 2 August 2029. The first anniversary is 7 November 2027.

Counting by hand, the different lengths of each month make it easy to slip by a day at month boundaries. CountDaysNow splits past, today and upcoming events into three views with exact day counts, and its calculator adds, subtracts and compares dates, so you can check the start date plus 99 days right away. Check once at the start whether the number shown counts the first day as day 0 or day 1.

Remembering is harder than calculating. CountDaysNow reminds you 7, 3 and 1 days before, on the day, on day 100 and every year, and shows the days left on Home Screen widgets, the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island. One countdown can be updated together with another CountDaysNow user, and share cards export in square, portrait and story formats.

steps: Create the start date as an event and check it in the past view.
In the date calculator, add 99 days to the start date to find day 100.
Turn on reminders 7, 3 and 1 days before and on the day, and check the day-100 and yearly reminders.

If you like, update the same countdown together with your partner or send a share card.

en.fits: CountDaysNow fits people who want to count both past and upcoming dates, such as the day they started dating, wedding anniversaries and birthdays. Each event can show a second calendar such as the lunar calendar next to the Gregorian date, and Apple Watch works offline. There are no ads and no account, no third-party analytics or tracking tools, and no data is sent to the developer's servers.
faq: How many days after the start date is day 100?
Counting the start date as day 1, day 100 is 99 days later. A calendar difference gives 99, so add one in your head.
Is the first anniversary day 365?
No. The first anniversary is the same date the next year. Counting the start as day 1, that is usually day 366, or day 367 if a leap day falls in between.

Ở những nơi này, nhiều tình huống thường ngày diễn ra bằng tiếng địa phương: nhận phòng, gọi món, hỏi đường. loc.h1: 收藏連結的正確做法：LINE、Instagram、瀏覽器的連結收在同一個地方
loc.lead: LINE 聊天室裡傳給自己的、Instagram 按了收藏的、Safari 加進書籤的：三個地方三堆連結，真的要用的時候一個都翻不到。
loc.answer: 連結找不回來，通常不是存太少，而是散在各 App 自己的收藏裡、存的時候又沒分類。解法是三件事：所有連結收進同一個不用註冊的地方、存下的當下就自動貼好主題標籤、每天固定讀掉幾則。SaveTag：AI 連結收藏 就是照這個方式運作：從分享選單或剪貼簿一鍵存，在裝置上自動分類，不用註冊帳號。
paras: 第一步，戒掉「在哪裡看到就收在哪裡」的習慣。LINE 的聊天室、Instagram 的收藏、瀏覽器的書籤各管各的，三個月後你根本想不起來那篇食譜在哪個 App。改成一條規則：不管從哪個 App 看到，值得留的連結都送到同一個地方。有分享選單的 App 直接按分享送過去；只能複製連結的，複製網址後從剪貼簿存。

第二步，讓標籤自己寫好。手動整理撐不過一週，所以要選存下當下就完成歸類的工具。SaveTag：AI 連結收藏 接受任何有分享選單的 App 一鍵分享進來，也能在複製網址後直接從剪貼簿快速存檔；標題、來源網站和預覽圖自動帶入，存完直接回到原本的畫面。每一筆會在裝置上分進購物、美食、食譜、旅遊、理財、育兒、穿搭等細主題，也會記住是從哪個來源存的。之後要找時，搜尋會一起看標題、筆記、標籤和來源，只記得大概意思也撈得回來；想不起關鍵字就直接翻主題。
第三步，真的回頭看。稍後閱讀清單沒有出口就會變成黑洞。SaveTag 的「重新發現」每天挑幾則還沒讀的送到面前，搭配目標圓環和連續天數，讀完一則就打勾，清單真的會變短而不是一直變長。所有資料留在你的 iPhone：不用註冊、不上雲端、沒有廣告、不做追蹤；自動標籤用的是 Apple 的裝置端文字智慧，不是聊天機器人。

faq: LINE 聊天室裡的連結可以存進去嗎？
可以。長按訊息裡的連結複製網址，再打開 SaveTag 從剪貼簿快速存檔；有分享選單的 App 則可以直接一鍵分享進來。

自動標籤使用 Apple 的裝置端文字智慧，在本機讀取內容分進購物、美食、旅遊等細主題；分錯的可以改到別的主題。
收藏會被上傳嗎？要註冊帳號嗎？
不用註冊、不上雲端、沒有廣告、不做追蹤，你存的東西不會離開這台 iPhone。

en.title: Where to save links from LINE, Instagram and the browser: one place, tagged on save
en.meta: Links vanish because they sit in each app's own favourites with no tags. One place, tags on save, a few read daily. SaveTag saves from the share sheet, no account.
en.h1: Saving links properly: LINE, Instagram and browser links in one place
en.lead: Sent to yourself in a LINE chat, saved on Instagram, bookmarked in Safari: three piles in three apps, and when you need one, none of them turns up.
en.answer: Links rarely get lost because you saved too few; they get lost because they sit in each app's own favourites and were saved without tags. The fix is three things: one collection that needs no account, topic tags written the moment you save, and a habit of reading a few each day. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks works exactly that way: one tap from the share sheet or clipboard, sorted on the device, no sign-up.
paras: First, drop the habit of saving wherever you happen to be. LINE chats, Instagram saves and browser bookmarks each keep their own pile, and three months later you cannot remember which app holds that recipe. Use one rule instead: anything worth keeping, from any app, goes to the same place. Apps with a share sheet can send it straight there; where you can only copy the link, copy the URL and save it from the clipboard.

Second, let the tags write themselves. Manual filing never survives a week, so pick a tool that files each save the moment it lands. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks takes a share from any app with a share sheet and can also quick-save from the clipboard after you copy a URL; title, source site and preview come in automatically, and you go straight back to what you were doing. Each save is sorted on the device into precise topics such as shopping, food, recipes, travel, finance, parenting and fashion, and its source is remembered. Search later runs across titles, notes, tags and sources, so a vague memory is enough, and you can browse by topic when no keyword comes to mind.

Third, actually come back. A read-later list with no exit becomes a black hole. SaveTag's Rediscover puts a few unread saves in front of you each day, with a goal ring and a streak, and you tick each one off as you read it, so the list shrinks instead of growing. Everything stays on your iPhone: no sign-up, no cloud, no ads, no tracking; the automatic tags use Apple's on-device text intelligence, not a chatbot.
look: Whether apps that only offer Copy Link (some chats) can be saved from the clipboard
Whether saves are filed the moment you save or left for you to sort later
Whether search finds things when you only remember the rough meaning
Whether something brings unread saves back to you every day
Whether an account is required and whether your saves are uploaded
steps: Apps with a share sheet (the browser, Instagram and so on): tap share and pick the collection app; you return to the original screen once it is saved.
Places that only let you copy the link: copy the URL, open the collection app and quick-save from the clipboard; title and preview fill in automatically.
After saving, glance at the automatic tag and move anything that landed in the wrong topic.
To find something, search by its rough meaning or browse topics such as food, travel or shopping.
Each evening open Rediscover, read the few it picks and tick them off, so the list genuinely gets shorter.

en.fits: SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks suits people who save more than they read: LINE, Instagram and browser links in one place, sorted on the device the moment you save, with Rediscover bringing a few unread saves back each day; no sign-up, no cloud, no ads. If you only ever save pages inside the browser, Safari bookmarks are enough.
faq: Can links from a LINE chat be saved?
Yes. Long-press the link in the message to copy it, then open SaveTag and quick-save from the clipboard; apps with a share sheet can share in with one tap.
How accurate are the automatic tags in SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks?
Tagging uses Apple's on-device text intelligence, reading the save locally and filing it into precise topics such as shopping, food or travel; anything filed wrongly can be moved to another topic.
Are my saves uploaded, and do I need an account?
No sign-up, no cloud, no ads, no tracking; what you save never leaves your iPhone.

loc.title: 台湾赴任・移住が決まったら：子どもの注音学習は出発前の何から始める？
loc.meta: 家族の台湾赴任や移住が決まり、子どもに注音（ボポモフォ）を学ばせたい保護者向け。出発前の数か月で、耳・声調・音節の順に家庭で準備する方法をまとめました。
loc.h1: 台湾赴任・移住前の注音学習：出発までに家庭でできる準備
loc.lead: 台湾への赴任や移住が決まると、子どもの言葉の準備が気になります。台湾の小学校では1年生のはじめに注音符号を習い、低学年の教科書には注音が添えられていることが多いです。出発前に全部覚える必要はありませんが、音に慣れておくだけで現地での最初の数週間がずっと楽になります。
loc.answer: 出発前の注音学習は、書けるようにすることより「聞いて分かる」ことを先にします。まず37の記号の音を耳で覚え、次に四声の聞き分け、最後に声母・介音・韻母をつないで音節を読む練習へ。1日10分ほどを毎日続け、書き順のなぞりは音に慣れてから加えるのが無理のない順番です。
paras: 日本の子どもにとって、注音はひらがなに少し似た「音を表す記号」です。ひらがなが一文字で一つの音を表すように、注音も記号で音を表し、それを組み合わせて一つの音節を作ります。違いは声調があることと、一つの音節が最大三つの記号（声母・介音・韻母）と声調記号でできていることです。この仕組みをひらがなにたとえて伝えると、子どもは受け入れやすくなります。
出発までの期間が限られる家庭ほど、順番が大切です。最初の数週間は記号の音を聞いて選ぶことだけに集中し、慣れてきたら同じ音節の四声を聞き分けます。音節を読む練習はその後です。Lumi ボポモフォでは、音を聞いて正しい記号を選んでフレンドにごはんをあげる遊び、声調コースターでの四声、サウンドトレインで声母・介音・韻母をつないで音節にする練習があり、この順番で取り組みやすい作りです。
保護者自身が中国語に不慣れでも大丈夫です。アプリが音を出してくれるので、親は発音のお手本になる必要がなく、そばで一緒に聞いて励ます役に回れます。毎日の復習で、まだ覚えていない記号がもう一度出てくるため、引っ越し準備で忙しい時期でも短時間で続けやすくなります。書き順どおりに指でなぞる練習は、音に慣れてから加えれば十分です。
look: 記号の音を耳で聞いて覚える練習があるか
四声を音節読みとは別に聞き分けられるか
声母・介音・韻母をつないで音節を作る練習があるか
覚えていない記号を毎日の復習で再び出してくれるか
広告なし・登録不要で、子どもに安心して渡せるか
steps: 出発時期から逆算し、1日10分の練習時間を生活の中に決めます。
最初の2〜3週間は、37の記号の音を聞いて選ぶ練習だけを続けます。
音に慣れたら、同じ音節を四声で聞き分ける練習を加えます。
次に声母・介音・韻母をつないで、短い音節を読む練習に進みます。
余裕が出てきたら、書き順どおりに記号をなぞる練習を足します。
rows: 音の聞き取りから始めているか
学校でも音に慣れることが土台になるため
音節読みとは別に練習しているか
日本語にない要素で、同時に覚えると混乱しやすい
二つの記号の音節から始めているか
介音の入る三つの記号の音節はつまずきやすい
アプリの音声に任せられるか
親の発音を手本にしなくても練習できる
loc.fits: Lumi ボポモフォは、台湾赴任や移住を前に、子どもに注音の音から慣れさせたい家庭に向いています。音を聞いて記号を選ぶ遊び、声調コースターでの四声、サウンドトレインでの音節づくり、書き順どおりのなぞり、毎日の復習があります。広告なし・登録不要で、進み具合は端末内にのみ保存されます。最初の記号は購入前に遊べ、37の記号とすべてのステージは1回のApp内課金で解放されます。
faq: 出発前に注音を全部覚えさせるべきですか？
全部でなくて大丈夫です。音を聞いて分かる記号が増えているだけで、現地の授業についていきやすくなります。
親が中国語を話せなくても教えられますか？
教えられます。音はアプリが出すので、親は一緒に聞いて、毎日続けられるように見守る役で十分です。
書く練習はいつから始めればいいですか？
記号の音に慣れてからで十分です。書き順どおりに指でなぞる練習から始めると、負担が少なくなります。

en.title: Moving to Taiwan with kids: where to start with zhuyin before you leave
en.meta: For parents whose family is relocating to Taiwan and who want their child to start learning zhuyin (bopomofo). How to prepare at home in the months before departure: listening first, then tones, then syllables.
en.h1: Zhuyin before moving to Taiwan: what families can prepare at home
en.lead: Once a work transfer or move to Taiwan is decided, many parents start worrying about their child's language. Taiwanese primary schools teach zhuyin at the start of first grade, and textbooks carry zhuyin alongside the characters. Your child does not need to master it before you leave, but getting used to the sounds makes the first weeks there much easier.
en.answer: Before the move, aim for understanding by ear rather than writing. First learn the sounds of the 37 symbols, then tell the four tones apart, and only then practise joining initial, medial and final into a syllable. About ten minutes a day works well; tracing the stroke order can come once the sounds feel familiar.
paras: For Japanese children, zhuyin feels a little like hiragana: symbols that stand for sounds and combine into syllables. The differences are the tones and that a syllable has up to three symbols (initial, medial, final) plus a tone mark. Explaining it through a familiar writing system often helps children accept it.

When time before departure is limited, order matters. Spend the first weeks only on hearing a sound and choosing the symbol, then add tone listening, and syllable reading after that. Lumi Bopomofo follows this order: listen and pick the right symbol to feed a friend, learn the four tones on the Tone Coaster, and join initial, medial and final into syllables on the Sound Train.

Parents who are not confident in Mandarin can still help. The app plays the sounds, so you do not have to model pronunciation; you listen along and encourage. Daily review brings back symbols your child has not learned yet, which keeps short sessions useful during a busy moving period. Tracing symbols in the correct stroke order can be added later.
look: Is there practice for learning each symbol's sound by ear?
Can tones be practised separately from syllable reading?
Is there practice for joining initial, medial and final into a syllable?
Does daily review bring back symbols the child has not learned yet?
Is it ad-free with no sign-up, so you can hand it to your child?
steps: Count back from your departure date and set a fixed ten-minute daily slot.
For the first two to three weeks, only practise hearing a sound and choosing among the 37 symbols.
Once the sounds feel familiar, add listening to one syllable in the four tones.
Then move on to reading short syllables built from initial, medial and final.
When there is room, add tracing the symbols in the correct stroke order.
rows: Classes there start from hearing the sounds

Japanese has no tones, so learning both at once confuses

Three-symbol syllables with a medial are the usual stumbling block

Practice works without a parent modelling pronunciation
en.fits: Lumi Bopomofo suits families preparing for a work transfer or move to Taiwan who want their child to get used to zhuyin sounds first. It includes listening to pick symbols, the Tone Coaster for the four tones, the Sound Train for building syllables, tracing in stroke order, and daily review. No ads, no sign-up, and progress is stored only on the device. The first symbol can be played before purchase; all 37 symbols and every stage unlock with a single in-app purchase.
faq: Should my child learn all of zhuyin before we move?
Not necessarily. Simply recognising more symbols by ear makes it easier to follow classes once you arrive.
Can I help if I don't speak Mandarin?
Yes. The app plays the sounds, so your role is to listen along and keep the daily habit going.
When should writing practice start?
Once the sounds feel familiar. Starting with tracing in the correct stroke order keeps it light.

loc.title: 칭찬 스티커판을 앱으로 바꿀 때, 부모가 먼저 정해야 할 규칙 5가지
loc.meta: 종이 칭찬 스티커판을 앱으로 바꾸려는 3~7세 아이 부모를 위한 글. 누가 탭할지, 미션은 몇 개로 할지, 보상은 언제 줄지 등 시작 전에 정해 두면 오래가는 규칙을 정리했습니다.
loc.h1: 칭찬 스티커판을 앱으로 바꾸기 전에 정할 규칙
loc.lead: 냉장고에 붙인 칭찬 스티커판은 처음 일주일은 잘 돌아가다가 어느새 스티커가 떨어지고, 누가 몇 장 붙였는지 헷갈리기 시작합니다. 앱으로 바꾸면 기록은 편해지지만, 규칙 없이 옮기기만 하면 같은 문제가 화면 안에서 반복됩니다.
loc.answer: 칭찬 스티커판을 앱으로 바꿀 때는 시작 전에 다섯 가지를 정하세요. 누가 탭하는지, 미션은 몇 개로 시작하는지, 성공 직후 바로 기록하는지, 하루를 놓쳤을 때 어떻게 하는지, 앱 밖의 보상을 줄지 말지입니다. 이 규칙을 아이와 함께 말로 정해 두면 앱이 잔소리 도구가 아니라 칭찬 도구로 남습니다.
paras: 첫째, 탭하는 사람을 정합니다. 3~7세라면 아이가 직접 탭하게 하는 편이 동기를 높이기 쉽지만, 기록이 정확해야 한다면 부모가 확인한 뒤 아이가 탭하는 방식으로 합의할 수 있습니다. 둘째, 미션 수는 적게 시작합니다. 식사, 양치, 잠자기, 장난감 정리처럼 매일 반복되는 일 몇 가지로 시작하고, 익숙해지면 하나씩 늘립니다.

셋째, 칭찬은 성공 직후에 합니다. 종이 스티커판에서 흔한 실패는 저녁에 몰아서 붙이는 것인데, 이러면 행동과 칭찬 사이가 멀어집니다. Lumi 미션 별은 아이가 작은 성공마다 화면을 한 번 탭하면 토끼 친구가 바로 반응하고, 미션을 끝내면 별 전체가 축하해 주도록 만들어져 있어 '지금 이 순간의 칭찬'을 지키기 쉽습니다. 넷째, 하루를 놓쳤을 때의 규칙도 미리 정합니다. 연속 기록이 끊겨도 다음 날 다시 시작하면 된다고 말해 두면 아이가 포기하지 않습니다.
다섯째, 앱 밖의 보상을 정합니다. 앱 안의 스티커와 친구 모으기만으로 충분한 아이도 있고, 주말에 작은 약속을 함께 정하는 가족도 있습니다. 어느 쪽이든 미리 정하고 바꾸지 않는 것이 중요합니다. 보호자 대시보드에서 오늘 요약과 7일 캘린더를 보며 일주일에 한 번 아이와 함께 돌아보면, 규칙이 아이에게 맞는지 조정할 수 있습니다.
